(2) Investigate noise pollution in a community or at a construction site and the control measures already taken, and propose further suggestions for controlling noise. (3) Make a simple telescope with convex lenses and use it to observe distant scenery. (4) Investigate light pollution in a community or city, and propose suggestions for improvement.

subject: science
text_zh: 观察摩擦起电现象，了解静电现象。了解生产生活中关于静电防止和利用的技术。例1举例说明生活中的静电现象。例2查阅资料，了解静电防止和利用的常用方法。
text_en: Observe the phenomenon of electrification by friction, and understand electrostatic phenomena. Understand techniques for preventing and utilizing static electricity in production and daily life. Example 1: Give examples to illustrate electrostatic phenomena in daily life. Example 2: Consult materials to learn common methods of preventing and utilizing static electricity.

subject: science
text_zh: 通过实验，认识磁场。知道地磁场。例3查阅资料，了解我国古代指南针的发明对人类社会发展的贡献。
text_en: Through experiments, recognize magnetic fields. Know the Earth's magnetic field. Example 3: Consult materials to learn about the contribution of the ancient Chinese invention of the compass to the development of human society.

subject: science
text_zh: 通过实验，了解电流周围存在磁场。探究并了解通电螺线管外部磁场的方向。了解电磁铁在生产生活中的应用。
text_en: Through experiments, understand that a magnetic field exists around an electric current. Investigate and understand the direction of the magnetic field outside a current-carrying solenoid. Understand applications of electromagnets in production and daily life.

subject: science
text_zh: 通过实验，了解通电导线在磁场中会受到力的作用，并知道力的方向与哪些因素有关。例4了解动圈式扬声器的结构和原理。例5了解直流电动机的工作原理。
text_en: Through experiments, understand that a current-carrying wire in a magnetic field experiences a force, and know which factors the direction of the force depends on. Example 4: Understand the structure and principle of the moving-coil loudspeaker. Example 5: Understand the working principle of a DC motor.

subject: science
text_zh: 探究并了解导体在磁场中运动时产生感应电流的条件。了解电磁感应在生产生活中的应用。例6了解发电机的工作原理。
text_en: Investigate and understand the conditions under which an induced current is produced when a conductor moves in a magnetic field. Understand applications of electromagnetic induction in production and daily life. Example 6: Understand the working principle of a generator.

subject: science
text_zh: 知道电磁波。知道电磁波在真空中的传播速度。知道波长、频率和波速。了解电磁波的应用及其对人类生活和社会发展的影响。例？举例说明电磁波的存在。例8了解广播电台节目的发射频率和波长。例9知道移动通信和卫星通信等都应用了电磁波。活动建议：（1）利用磁体和缝衣针制作指南针，验证同名磁极相互排斥、昇名磁极相互吸引。（2）查阅资料，了解我国北斗卫星导航系统的作用和优势，讨论电磁波在卫星通信技术中的应用。（3）查阅资料，了解我国磁悬浮列车的发展状况，讨论电磁技术在其中的应用。
text_en: Know electromagnetic waves. Know the speed of propagation of electromagnetic waves in a vacuum. Know wavelength, frequency and wave speed. Understand applications of electromagnetic waves and their influence on human life and social development. Example 7: Give examples to illustrate the existence of electromagnetic waves. Example 8: Understand the transmission frequencies and wavelengths of radio station programmes. Example 9: Know that mobile communication, satellite communication and the like all use electromagnetic waves. Suggested activities: (1) Make a compass from a magnet and a sewing needle, and verify that like magnetic poles repel and unlike magnetic poles attract. (2) Consult materials to learn about the role and advantages of China's BeiDou satellite navigation system, and discuss the application of electromagnetic waves in satellite communication technology. (3) Consult materials to learn about the development of China's maglev trains, and discuss the application of electromagnetic technology in them.

subject: science
topic_zh: 能量、能量的转化和转移
topic_en: Energy, Energy Transformation, and Energy Transfer
text_zh: 了解能量及其存在的不同形式。能描述不同形式的能量和生产生活的联系。例1列举几种与生活密切相关的能量。
text_en: Understand energy and the different forms in which it exists. Be able to describe how different forms of energy are related to production and daily life. Example 1: List several kinds of energy closely related to daily life.

subject: science
topic_zh: 能量、能量的转化和转移
topic_en: Energy, Energy Transformation, and Energy Transfer
text_zh: 通过实验，认识能量可以从一个物体转移到其他物体，不同形式的能量可以相互转化。例2列举生活中能量转移和转化的实例。
text_en: Through experiments, recognize that energy can be transferred from one object to other objects and that different forms of energy can be converted into one another. Example 2: List examples of energy transfer and conversion in daily life.

subject: science
topic_zh: 能量、能量的转化和转移
topic_en: Energy, Energy Transformation, and Energy Transfer
text_zh: 结合实例，认识功的概念。知道做功的过程就是能量转化或转移的过程。活动建议：（1）列举太阳能在地球上转化为其他形式能量的实例。（2）讨论人在滑滑梯过程中能量转化的情况。
text_en: With the help of examples, recognize the concept of work. Know that the process of doing work is a process of energy conversion or transfer. Suggested activities: (1) List examples of solar energy on Earth being converted into other forms of energy. (2) Discuss the energy conversions that take place when a person slides down a slide.

subject: science
text_zh: 知道机械功和功率。用生活中的实例说明机械功和功率的含义。
text_en: Know mechanical work and power. Use examples from daily life to illustrate the meaning of mechanical work and power.

subject: science
text_zh: 知道机械效率。了解提高机械效率的意义和途径。例3测量某种简单机械的机械效率。
text_en: Know mechanical efficiency. Understand the significance of, and ways to, improve mechanical efficiency. Example 3: Measure the mechanical efficiency of a simple machine.

subject: science
text_zh: 能说出人类使用的一些机械。了解机械的使用对社会发展的作用。活动建议：（1）查阅资料，了解人类利用机械的大致历程，并与同学进行交流。（2）查阅资料，了解我国古代水磨、水碓等机械，写一篇弘扬中华优秀传统文化的调查报告。
text_en: Be able to name some machines used by humans. Understand the role of the use of machines in social development. Suggested activities: (1) Consult materials to learn in broad outline how humans have used machines, and exchange views with classmates. (2) Consult materials to learn about ancient Chinese machines such as the water mill and the water-powered trip hammer, and write an investigation report promoting China's fine traditional culture.

subject: science
text_zh: 了解内能和热量。从能量转化的角度认识燃料的热值。
text_en: Understand internal energy and heat. Recognize the calorific value of fuels from the perspective of energy conversion.

subject: science
text_zh: 通过实验，了解比热容。能运用比热容说明简单的自然现象。例1能运用比热容说明为什么沙漠中的昼夜温差比海边的大。
text_en: Through experiments, understand specific heat capacity. Be able to use specific heat capacity to explain simple natural phenomena. Example 1: Be able to use specific heat capacity to explain why the temperature difference between day and night in a desert is greater than at the seaside.

subject: science
text_zh: 了解热机的工作原理。知道内能的利用在人类社会发展史中的重要意义。例2了解热机对社会发展所起的作用和对环境的影响。活动建议：（1）调查当地近年来炊事、取暖、交通等方面燃料结构的变化，从经济与环保的角度开展讨论。（2）燃料的种类很多，如木柴、煤、汽油、酒精、天然气等，查阅资料并比较相同质量的不同燃料完全燃烧时放出热量的多少。
text_en: Understand the working principle of heat engines. Know the important significance of the use of internal energy in the history of human social development. Example 2: Understand the role heat engines have played in social development and their impact on the environment. Suggested activities: (1) Investigate changes in the local fuel mix in recent years for cooking, heating, transport and so on, and hold a discussion from the perspectives of economy and environmental protection. (2) There are many kinds of fuel, such as firewood, coal, petrol, alcohol and natural gas; consult materials and compare the amounts of heat released when equal masses of different fuels burn completely.

subject: science
text_zh: 从能量转化的角度认识电源和用电器的作用。例1定性说明电热水壶、电风扇工作时能量转化的情况。
text_en: Recognize the roles of power sources and electrical appliances from the perspective of energy conversion. Example 1: Explain qualitatively the energy conversions when an electric kettle or an electric fan is working.

subject: science
text_zh: 知道电压、电流和电阻。探究电流与电压、电阻的关系，理解欧姆定律。
text_en: Know voltage, current and resistance. Investigate the relationship of current to voltage and resistance, and understand Ohm's law.

subject: science
text_zh: 会看、会画简单的电路图。会连接简单的串联电路和并联电路。能说出生产生活中采用简单串联电路或并联电路的实例。探究并了解串联电路和并联电路中电流、电压的特点。
text_en: Be able to read and draw simple circuit diagrams. Be able to connect simple series circuits and parallel circuits. Be able to name examples in production and daily life where a simple series circuit or parallel circuit is used. Investigate and understand the characteristics of current and voltage in series circuits and parallel circuits.

subject: science
text_zh: 结合实例，了解电功和电功率。知道用电器的额定功率和实际功率。例2调查常见用电器的铭牌，比较它们的电功率。
text_en: With the help of examples, understand electric work and electric power. Know the rated power and actual power of an electrical appliance. Example 2: Investigate the nameplates of common electrical appliances and compare their electric power.

subject: science
text_zh: 通过实验，了解焦耳定律。能用焦耳定律说明生产生活中的有关现象。
text_en: Through experiments, understand Joule's law. Be able to use Joule's law to explain relevant phenomena in production and daily life.

subject: science
text_zh: 了解家庭电路的组成。有安全用电和节约用电的意识。例3了解我国家庭用电的电压和频率，在家庭用电中有保护自己和他人的安全意识。活动建议：（1）学读家用电能表，根据读数计算用电量。（2）调查当地人均用电量的变化，讨论它与当地经济发展的关系。
text_en: Understand the composition of a household circuit. Have an awareness of using electricity safely and economically. Example 3: Learn about the voltage and frequency of household electricity in China, and have an awareness of protecting the safety of oneself and others when using electricity at home. Suggested activities: (1) Learn to read a household electricity meter and calculate the amount of electricity used from the readings. (2) Investigate changes in local per capita electricity consumption and discuss its relationship with local economic development.

subject: science
text_zh: 知道能量守恒定律。列举日常生活中能量守恒的实例。有用能量转化与守恒的观点分析问题的意识。
text_en: Know the law of conservation of energy. List examples of energy conservation in daily life. Have an awareness of analysing problems from the viewpoint of energy conversion and conservation.

subject: science
text_zh: 从能量转化和转移的角度认识效率。
text_en: Recognize efficiency from the perspective of energy conversion and transfer.

subject: science
text_zh: 列举能量转化和转移具有方向性的常见实例。活动建议：（1）查阅资料或访问农机、汽车维修等专业人员，了解内燃机中燃料燃烧所释放热量的去向，讨论提高效率的可能途径。（2）调查当地主要炉灶的能量利用效率，写出调查报告。
text_en: List common examples showing that energy conversion and transfer have a direction. Suggested activities: (1) Consult materials, or interview agricultural machinery or car repair professionals, to learn where the heat released by fuel burning in an internal combustion engine goes, and discuss possible ways to improve efficiency. (2) Investigate the energy utilization efficiency of the main local stoves and write an investigation report.

subject: science
text_zh: 列举常见的不可再生能源和可再生能源。
text_en: List common non-renewable energy sources and renewable energy sources.

subject: science
text_zh: 知道核能的特点和核能利用可能带来的问题。例1了解处理核废料的常用方法。
text_en: Know the characteristics of nuclear energy and the problems that its use may bring. Example 1: Learn about common methods of handling nuclear waste.

subject: science
text_zh: 从能源开发与利用的角度体会可持续发展的重要性。例2了解太阳能、风能、氢能等能源的开发对可持续发展的意义。活动建议：（1）查阅资料，举办小型研讨会，讨论能源利用带来的环境影响，如大气污染、酸雨、温室效应等，探讨可采取的应对措施。（2）查阅资料，了解我国新能源汽车的发展概况。（3）了解有关提倡低碳生活的信息，调查当地使用的主要能源及其对当地经济和环境的影响，提出开发当地可再生能源的建议。（4）查阅资料，了解受控核聚变（人造太阳）的研究进展，了解我国在这方面的研究成就。
text_en: Appreciate the importance of sustainable development from the perspective of the development and use of energy. Example 2: Learn about the significance of developing energy sources such as solar, wind and hydrogen energy for sustainable development. Suggested activities: (1) Consult materials and hold a small seminar to discuss the environmental impact of energy use, such as air pollution, acid rain and the greenhouse effect, and explore countermeasures that can be taken. (2) Consult materials to learn about the development of new-energy vehicles in China. (3) Learn about information promoting low-carbon living, investigate the main energy sources used locally and their impact on the local economy and environment, and put forward suggestions for developing local renewable energy. (4) Consult materials to learn about research progress in controlled nuclear fusion (the "artificial sun") and China's research achievements in this area.

subject: science
text_zh: 用托盘天平测量物体的质量。例1用托盘天平测量小木块和杯中水的质量。
text_en: Use a platform balance (tray balance) to measure the mass of an object. Example 1: Use a platform balance to measure the mass of a small wooden block and of the water in a cup.

subject: science
text_zh: 测量固体和液体的密度。例2用天平、量筒等测量小石块和盐水的密度。
text_en: Measure the density of solids and liquids. Example 2: Use a balance, a measuring cylinder and so on to measure the density of a small stone and of salt water.

subject: science
text_zh: 用常见温度计测量温度。例3用实验室温度计测量水的温度，用体温计测量自己的体温。
text_en: Use common thermometers to measure temperature. Example 3: Use a laboratory thermometer to measure the temperature of water, and use a clinical thermometer to measure one's own body temperature.

subject: science
text_zh: 用刻度尺测量长度，用表测量时间。例4用刻度尺测量物理教科书的长和宽，利用具有秒表功能的设备测量自己脉搏跳动30次所用的时间。
text_en: Use a ruler to measure length, and a timepiece to measure time. Example 4: Use a ruler to measure the length and width of a physics textbook, and use a device with a stopwatch function to measure the time taken for one's own pulse to beat 30 times.

subject: science
text_zh: 测量物体运动的速度。例5用秒表和刻度尺，测量小球通过某段距离的速度。
text_en: Measure the speed of an object's motion. Example 5: Use a stopwatch and a ruler to measure the speed at which a ball travels over a certain distance.

subject: science
text_zh: 用弹簧测力计测量力。例6用手拉动弹簧测力计体验1N、2N、4N力的大小，测量一本物理教科书所受的重力。
text_en: Use a spring balance (spring force gauge) to measure force. Example 6: Pull a spring balance by hand to feel forces of 1 N, 2 N and 4 N, and measure the weight of a physics textbook.

subject: science
text_zh: 用电流表测量电流。例7用实验室指针式电流表，测量直流电路中的电流。
text_en: Use an ammeter to measure current. Example 7: Use a laboratory pointer-type ammeter to measure the current in a DC circuit.

subject: science
text_zh: 用电压表测量电压。例8用实验室指针式电压表，测量直流电路中的电压。
text_en: Use a voltmeter to measure voltage. Example 8: Use a laboratory pointer-type voltmeter to measure the voltage in a DC circuit.

subject: science
text_zh: 用电流表和电压表测量电阻。例9用电流表、电压表、滑动变阻器等，测量小灯泡正常发光时的电阻。活动建议：（1）蜡块会漂浮在水面上，尝试用天平和量筒测量蜡块的密度。（2）用电子天平测量一些家用物品的质量，感受电子天平在操作上的优，点，体会科技进步给人类生活带来的影响。
text_en: Use an ammeter and a voltmeter to measure resistance. Example 9: Use an ammeter, a voltmeter, a sliding rheostat and so on to measure the resistance of a small bulb when it glows at its rated (normal) brightness. Suggested activities: (1) A wax block floats on the surface of water; try to measure its density with a balance and a measuring cylinder. (2) Use an electronic balance to measure the mass of some household articles, feel the advantages of the electronic balance in operation, and appreciate the influence of technological progress on human life.

subject: science
text_zh: 探究水在沸腾前后温度变化的特点。例1用酒精灯、烧杯、温度计等，探究水在沸腾前后温度变化的特点。
text_en: Investigate the characteristics of how the temperature of water changes before and after boiling. Example 1: Use an alcohol burner, a beaker, a thermometer and so on to investigate how the temperature of water changes before and after boiling.

subject: science
text_zh: 探究滑动摩擦力大小与哪些因素有关。例2用弹簧测力计、平板、细绳、长方体物块、棉布、毛巾等，探究滑动摩擦力大小与哪些因素有关。
text_en: Investigate which factors the magnitude of sliding friction depends on. Example 2: Use a spring balance, a flat board, a string, a rectangular block, cotton cloth, a towel and so on to investigate which factors the magnitude of sliding friction depends on.

subject: science
text_zh: 探究液体压强与哪些因素有关。例3用水、盐水、压强计等，探究液体压强与哪些因素有关。
text_en: Investigate which factors liquid pressure depends on. Example 3: Use water, salt water, a pressure gauge (manometer) and so on to investigate which factors liquid pressure depends on.

subject: science
text_zh: 探究浮力大小与哪些因素有关。例4用水、盐水、金属块、弹簧测力计等，探究金属块所受浮力与哪些因素有关。
text_en: Investigate which factors the magnitude of buoyancy depends on. Example 4: Use water, salt water, a metal block, a spring balance and so on to investigate which factors the buoyancy on a metal block depends on.

subject: science
text_zh: 探究杠杆的平衡条件。例5用杠杆、铁架台、钩码和弹簧测力计，探究杠杆平衡时动力、动力臂与阻力、阻力臂之间的定量关系。
text_en: Investigate the condition for equilibrium of a lever. Example 5: Use a lever, a retort stand, hooked masses and a spring balance to investigate the quantitative relationship between the effort (driving force), effort arm, resistance (load) and resistance arm when a lever is in equilibrium.

subject: science
text_zh: 探究光的反射定律。例6用激光笔、平面镜、光屏及量角器等探究光的反射定律。
text_en: Investigate the law of reflection of light. Example 6: Use a laser pointer, a plane mirror, a screen, a protractor and so on to investigate the law of reflection of light.

subject: science
text_zh: 探究平面镜成像的特点。例7用蜡烛（或其他物品）、平板玻璃、刻度尺、白纸等，探究平面镜成像时，像的大小、位置、虚实等有什么特点。
text_en: Investigate the characteristics of imaging by a plane mirror. Example 7: Use a candle (or another object), a flat glass plate, a ruler, white paper and so on to investigate the characteristics of the image in plane-mirror imaging, such as its size, position, and whether it is virtual or real.

subject: science
text_zh: 探究凸透镜成像的规律。例8用蜡烛（或F形光源）、凸透镜、光具座、光屏等，探究凸透镜成像时，像的正倒、大小、位置、虚实等与物距的关系。
text_en: Investigate the rules of imaging by a convex lens. Example 8: Use a candle (or an F-shaped light source), a convex lens, an optical bench, a screen and so on to investigate how the characteristics of the image in convex-lens imaging (upright or inverted, size, position, virtual or real) relate to the object distance.

subject: science
text_zh: 探究通电螺线管外部磁场的方向。例9用小磁针、通电螺线管等，探究通电螺线管外部磁场的方向。
text_en: Investigate the direction of the magnetic field outside a current-carrying solenoid. Example 9: Use small magnetic needles, a current-carrying solenoid and so on to investigate the direction of the magnetic field outside a current-carrying solenoid.

subject: science
text_zh: 探究导体在磁场中运动时产生感应电流的条件。例10用矩形线圈或单根导线、磁体、灵敏电流计等探究产生感应电流的条件。
text_en: Investigate the conditions under which an induced current is produced when a conductor moves in a magnetic field. Example 10: Use a rectangular coil or a single wire, a magnet, a sensitive galvanometer and so on to investigate the conditions for producing an induced current.

subject: science
text_zh: 探究串联电路和并联电路中电流、电压的特点。例11用电流表和电压表，分别探究串联电路和并联电路中电流、电压的特点。
text_en: Investigate the characteristics of current and voltage in series circuits and parallel circuits. Example 11: Use an ammeter and a voltmeter to investigate the characteristics of current and voltage in a series circuit and in a parallel circuit respectively.

subject: science
text_zh: 探究电流与电压、电阻的关系。例12用定值电阻、滑动变阻器、电流表、电压表等，探究电流与电压、电阻的关系。活动建议：（1）用可变焦距的眼睛模型，演示并说明近视眼、远视眼看不清物体的原因。（2）尝试用力传感器探究影响浮力大小的因素或杠杆的平衡条件。
text_en: Investigate the relationship of current to voltage and resistance. Example 12: Use fixed resistors, a sliding rheostat, an ammeter, a voltmeter and so on to investigate the relationship of current to voltage and resistance. Suggested activities: (1) Use an eye model with adjustable focal length to demonstrate and explain why people with myopia and hyperopia cannot see objects clearly. (2) Try using a force sensor to investigate the factors that affect the magnitude of buoyancy or the condition for equilibrium of a lever.

subject: science
text_zh: 能运用所学知识分析日常生活中的安全问题，提出解决方案，践行安全与健康生活。例2调查生活中（如用电、乘车、住高楼等）存在的安全隐患，提出安全与健康生活的建议。
text_en: Be able to use what has been learned to analyse safety problems in daily life, propose solutions, and put safe and healthy living into practice. Example 2: Investigate hidden safety hazards in daily life (such as in using electricity, travelling by vehicle, and living in high-rise buildings), and propose suggestions for safe and healthy living.

subject: science
text_zh: 能运用所学知识指导和规范个人行为，践行低碳生活，具有节能环保意识。例3了解当地空气质量状况，并调查相关原因。例4拟订《个人低碳生活行为指南》，对个人节能环保行为提出具体要求。活动建议：（1）通过资料查阅、商店咨询和实物考察，分析自行车中涉及的不同学科知识，选择感兴趣的主题撰写一篇小论文。（2）通过资料查阅和实物考察，探索家庭用电的安全问题，从跨学科视角撰写简单的调查报告。（3）通过资料查阅和实物考察，了解机动车的尾气排放情况，撰写关于城市空气污染和汽车尾气排放的调查报告。
text_en: Be able to use what has been learned to guide and regulate one's personal behaviour, put low-carbon living into practice, and have an awareness of saving energy and protecting the environment. Example 3: Learn about local air quality and investigate the relevant causes. Example 4: Draw up a "Guide to Personal Low-Carbon Living Behaviour", setting out specific requirements for personal energy-saving and environmental protection behaviour. Suggested activities: (1) Through consulting materials, asking in shops and examining real objects, analyse the knowledge from different subjects involved in a bicycle, and choose a topic of interest on which to write a short paper. (2) Through consulting materials and examining real objects, explore safety problems of household electricity use, and write a simple investigation report from an interdisciplinary perspective. (3) Through consulting materials and examining real objects, learn about exhaust emissions from motor vehicles, and write an investigation report on urban air pollution and vehicle exhaust emissions.

subject: science
text_zh: 了解我国古代的技术应用案例，体会我国古代科技对人类文明发展的促进作用。例1了解我国古代“龙骨水车”的工作原理，尝试设计相关装置。
text_en: Learn about examples of the application of technology in ancient China, and appreciate how ancient Chinese science and technology promoted the development of human civilization. Example 1: Learn about the working principle of the ancient Chinese "dragon-spine water wheel" (square-pallet chain pump) and try to design a related device.

subject: science
text_zh: 调查物理学应用于工程技术的案例，体会物理学对工程技术发展的促进作用。例2调查物理学在桥梁建筑技术方面的应用案例，体会物理学对桥梁发展的促进作用。
text_en: Investigate examples of physics applied in engineering and technology, and appreciate how physics has promoted the development of engineering and technology. Example 2: Investigate examples of the application of physics in bridge construction technology, and appreciate how physics has promoted the development of bridges.

subject: science
text_zh: 了解物理学在信息技术中的应用。例3了解物理学在信息记录或传播中的应用。活动建议：（1）制作一台小型风力发电机，从跨学科视角与同学交流制作过程与作品。（2）查阅资料，了解物理学对信息技术发展的贡献。（3）查阅资料，了解量子计算机相关信息，与同学交流对计算机未来发展的畅想。
text_en: Understand the application of physics in information technology. Example 3: Learn about the application of physics in the recording or transmission of information. Suggested activities: (1) Make a small wind-power generator, and discuss the making process and the finished work with classmates from an interdisciplinary perspective. (2) Consult materials to learn about the contribution of physics to the development of information technology. (3) Consult materials to learn about quantum computers, and exchange with classmates one's ideas about the future of computing.

subject: science
text_zh: 结合实例，尝试分析能源的开发与利用对社会发展的影响。例1查阅资料并举办报告会，讨论能源利用对环境的影响，结合对当地能源利用现状的调查，提出改进建议。
text_en: With the help of examples, try to analyse the influence of the development and use of energy on social development. Example 1: Consult materials and hold a report meeting to discuss the influence of energy use on the environment, and, combined with an investigation of the current state of local energy use, propose suggestions for improvement.

subject: science
text_zh: 结合实例，了解一些新材料的特点及其应用。了解新材料的研发与应用对社会发展的影响。例2了解半导体、超导体的主要特点，展望超导体应用对社会发展的影响。例3了解纳米材料等新型材料的主要特点，以及这些新材料技术的应用对社会发展的影响。
text_en: With the help of examples, understand the characteristics and applications of some new materials. Understand the influence of the research, development and application of new materials on social development. Example 2: Learn about the main characteristics of semiconductors and superconductors, and look ahead to the influence of superconductor applications on social development. Example 3: Learn about the main characteristics of new materials such as nanomaterials, and the influence of applying these new material technologies on social development.

subject: science
text_zh: 了解我国科技发展的成就，增强科技强国的责任感和使命感。例4了解我国“两弹一星”的成就，体会科技作为国家发展战略支撑的重大意义，树立科技自立自强的信念；知道赵忠尧、钱学森、邓稼先等科学家的杰出贡献和爱国情怀，发扬勇攀科技高峰的精神。活动建议：（1）查阅资料，了解深海、太空等的开发与利用对人类社会发展的意义，撰写一篇小论文。（2）查阅资料，了解环境污染治理比较成功的案例，撰写一篇调查报告。（3）查阅资料，了解手机改进历程中的典型案例，体会通信技术的进步对社会发展的影响。
text_en: Learn about China's achievements in science and technology development, and strengthen one's sense of responsibility and mission for making China a strong country in science and technology. Example 4: Learn about China's "Two Bombs, One Satellite" achievements, appreciate the great significance of science and technology as a strategic support for national development, and establish the conviction of scientific and technological self-reliance and strength; know the outstanding contributions and patriotism of scientists such as Zhao Zhongyao, Qian Xuesen and Deng Jiaxian, and carry forward the spirit of daring to climb the peaks of science and technology. Suggested activities: (1) Consult materials to learn about the significance of developing and using the deep sea, outer space and so on for human social development, and write a short paper. (2) Consult materials to learn about relatively successful cases of environmental pollution control, and write an investigation report. (3) Consult materials to learn about typical cases in the history of improvements to the mobile phone, and appreciate the influence of advances in communication technology on social development.

subject: science
text_zh: 知道化学是研究物质的组成、结构、性质、转化及应用的一门基础学科，其特征是从分子层次认识物质，通过化学变化创造物质；初步了解化学科学的发展历程，体会实验探究和模型建构是化学科学研究的基本方法；认识化学科学、技术、社会、环境的相互关系，了解化学科学对社会发展和人类文明进步的重要价值。
text_en: Know that chemistry is a fundamental discipline that studies the composition, structure, properties, transformation and application of substances, characterized by understanding substances at the molecular level and creating substances through chemical change; gain a preliminary understanding of the development of chemistry, and appreciate that experimental inquiry and model construction are the basic methods of chemical research; recognize the interrelationships among chemistry, technology, society and the environment, and understand the important value of chemistry for social development and the progress of human civilization.

subject: science
text_zh: 感悟科学家崇尚真理、严谨求实的科学态度，勇于质疑、批判和创新的精神；学习科学家爱国、奉献的精神，团结协作、攻坚克难的品格。
text_en: Appreciate scientists' scientific attitude of revering truth and being rigorous and realistic, and their spirit of daring to question, critique and innovate; learn from scientists' patriotism and spirit of dedication, and their qualities of teamwork and perseverance in overcoming difficulties.

subject: science
text_zh: 知道科学探究是收集证据和作出解释，进行发现、创造与应用的科学实践活动，也是获取科学知识、理解科学本质、认识客观世界的重要途径。
text_en: Know that scientific inquiry is a scientific practice of collecting evidence and constructing explanations, of discovery, creation and application, and is also an important way to acquire scientific knowledge, understand the nature of science and understand the objective world.

subject: science
text_zh: 了解科学探究过程包括提出问题、形成假设、设计并实施实验或调查方案、获取证据、分析解释数据、形成结论及建构模型、反思评价及表达交流等要素。
text_en: Understand that the process of scientific inquiry includes elements such as posing questions, forming hypotheses, designing and carrying out experiments or investigation plans, obtaining evidence, analyzing and interpreting data, drawing conclusions and constructing models, reflecting and evaluating, and expressing and communicating.

subject: science
text_zh: 经历科学探究的一般过程，认识从问题和假设出发确定探究目标、依据探究目标设计并实施实验方案、通过观察和实验等方法获取证据、基于证据进行分析推理及形成结论等对于科学探究的意义，体会合作与交流在科学探究中的重要作用。
text_en: Experience the general process of scientific inquiry; recognize the significance for scientific inquiry of setting inquiry goals starting from questions and hypotheses, designing and carrying out experimental plans according to those goals, obtaining evidence through methods such as observation and experiment, and analyzing, reasoning and drawing conclusions based on evidence; appreciate the important role of cooperation and communication in scientific inquiry.

subject: science
text_zh: 知道化学实验是进行科学探究的重要方式，具备基本的化学实验技能是学习化学和进行探究活动的基础和保证。
text_en: Know that chemical experiments are an important means of conducting scientific inquiry, and that possessing basic chemical experimental skills is the foundation and guarantee for learning chemistry and carrying out inquiry activities.

subject: science
text_zh: 对于化学实验技能，应达到如下基本要求。
text_en: With regard to chemical experimental skills, the following basic requirements should be met.

subject: science
text_zh: （1）熟悉化学实验室安全警示标志，学会正确使用安全防护设施，学习妥善应对实验安全问题的必要措施。
text_en: (1) Be familiar with chemical laboratory safety warning signs, learn to use safety protection facilities correctly, and learn the necessary measures for properly dealing with laboratory safety problems.

subject: science
text_zh: （2）学会试剂的取用、简单仪器的使用及连接、加热等实验基本操作。
text_en: (2) Learn basic experimental operations such as taking reagents, using and connecting simple apparatus, and heating.

subject: science
text_zh: （3）初步学会在教师指导下根据实验需要选择实验试剂和仪器，并能安全操作。
text_en: (3) Begin to learn, under the teacher's guidance, to select reagents and apparatus according to experimental needs and to operate them safely.

subject: science
text_zh: （4）初步学会配制一定溶质质量分数的溶液。
text_en: (4) Begin to learn to prepare solutions with a given solute mass fraction.

subject: science
text_zh: （5）学会用酸碱指示剂、pH试纸检验溶液的酸碱性。
text_en: (5) Learn to test the acidity or alkalinity of solutions using acid-base indicators and pH paper.

subject: science
text_zh: （6）初步学会根据某些性质检验和区分一些常见的物质。
text_en: (6) Begin to learn to test for and distinguish some common substances based on certain properties.

subject: science
text_zh: （7）初步学习使用过滤、蒸发的方法对混合物进行分离。
text_en: (7) Begin to learn to separate mixtures by filtration and evaporation.

subject: science
text_zh: （8）初步学习运用简单的装置和方法制取某些气体。
text_en: (8) Begin to learn to prepare certain gases using simple apparatus and methods.

subject: science
text_zh: （9）初步学会观察实验现象，并如实记录、处理实验数据，撰写实验报告等技能。
text_en: (9) Begin to learn skills such as observing experimental phenomena, recording and processing experimental data truthfully, and writing experiment reports.

subject: science
topic_zh: 1.3 化学实验探究的思路与方法
topic_en: 1.3 Approaches and Methods of Chemistry Experimental Inquiry
text_zh: 通过具体的实验活动初步形成化学实验探究的一般思路与方法，知道围绕实验目的确定实验原理，选择实验仪器，组装实验装置，设计实验步骤，实施实验并完成实验记录，基于实验事实得出结论。
text_en: Through concrete experimental activities, begin to form a general approach and method for chemical experimental inquiry; know how to determine the experimental principle around the purpose of the experiment, select apparatus, assemble the experimental setup, design the experimental steps, carry out the experiment and complete the experimental record, and draw conclusions based on experimental facts.

subject: science
topic_zh: 1.3 化学实验探究的思路与方法
topic_en: 1.3 Approaches and Methods of Chemistry Experimental Inquiry
text_zh: 通过具体的化学实验探究活动，学习研究物质性质，探究物质组成和反应规律，进行物质分离、检验和制备等不同类型化学实验探究活动的一般思路与基本方法；学习控制变量和对比实验的实验设计方法。
text_en: Through concrete chemical experimental inquiry activities, learn the general approaches and basic methods of different types of chemical experimental inquiry, such as studying the properties of substances, investigating the composition of substances and the laws of reactions, and carrying out the separation, testing and preparation of substances; learn experimental design methods such as controlling variables and comparative experiments.

subject: science
topic_zh: 1.3 化学实验探究的思路与方法
topic_en: 1.3 Approaches and Methods of Chemistry Experimental Inquiry
text_zh: 通过化学科学发展历程中的经典实验，学习和体会化学家进行科学探究的智慧和方法，理解科学探究的本质。
text_en: Through classic experiments in the history of chemistry, learn from and appreciate the wisdom and methods of chemists in conducting scientific inquiry, and understand the nature of scientific inquiry.

subject: science
text_zh: 发展科学探究的好奇心、想象力与探究欲；通过探究活动，初步养成注重实证、严谨求实的科学态度，初步学会批判性思维方法，具有敢于提出并坚持自己的见解、勇于修正或放弃错误观点、反对伪科学的科学精神。
text_en: Develop curiosity, imagination and the desire to inquire in scientific inquiry; through inquiry activities, begin to cultivate a scientific attitude of valuing evidence and being rigorous and realistic, begin to learn critical thinking methods, and develop a scientific spirit of daring to put forward and hold to one's own views, being willing to correct or abandon mistaken views, and opposing pseudoscience.

subject: science
text_zh: 树立自觉的安全意识和观念，知道化学实验存在安全风险，明确化学实验室安全规则和实验操作规范，了解实验室基本布局，学会正确使用安全防护设施，养成节约和环保的习惯。
text_en: Establish a conscious sense of safety, know that chemical experiments involve safety risks, be clear about chemical laboratory safety rules and standards for experimental operation, understand the basic layout of the laboratory, learn to use safety protection facilities correctly, and develop habits of conserving resources and protecting the environment.

subject: science
topic_zh: 1.5 学生必做实验及实践活动
topic_en: 1.5 Required Student Experiments and Practical Activities
text_zh: （1）粗盐中难溶性杂质的去除。
text_en: (1) Removal of insoluble impurities from crude salt.

subject: science
topic_zh: 1.5 学生必做实验及实践活动
topic_en: 1.5 Required Student Experiments and Practical Activities
text_zh: （2）氧气的实验室制取与性质。
text_en: (2) Laboratory preparation and properties of oxygen.

subject: science
topic_zh: 1.5 学生必做实验及实践活动
topic_en: 1.5 Required Student Experiments and Practical Activities
text_zh: （3）二氧化碳的实验室制取与性质。
text_en: (3) Laboratory preparation and properties of carbon dioxide.

subject: science
topic_zh: 1.5 学生必做实验及实践活动
topic_en: 1.5 Required Student Experiments and Practical Activities
text_zh: （4）常见金属的物理性质和化学性质。
text_en: (4) Physical and chemical properties of common metals.

subject: science
topic_zh: 1.5 学生必做实验及实践活动
topic_en: 1.5 Required Student Experiments and Practical Activities
text_zh: （5）常见酸、碱的化学性质。
text_en: (5) Chemical properties of common acids and bases.

subject: science
topic_zh: 1.5 学生必做实验及实践活动
topic_en: 1.5 Required Student Experiments and Practical Activities
text_zh: （6）一定溶质质量分数的氯化钠溶液的配制。
text_en: (6) Preparation of a sodium chloride solution with a given solute mass fraction.

subject: science
topic_zh: 1.5 学生必做实验及实践活动
topic_en: 1.5 Required Student Experiments and Practical Activities
text_zh: （7）水的组成及变化的探究。
text_en: (7) Investigation of the composition and changes of water.

subject: science
topic_zh: 1.5 学生必做实验及实践活动
topic_en: 1.5 Required Student Experiments and Practical Activities
text_zh: （9）跨学科实践活动（原则上从学习主题5中选择，所用课时不少于本学科总课时的10%）。
text_en: (9) Interdisciplinary practical activities (in principle chosen from Learning Theme 5, taking no less than 10% of the total class hours of the subject).

subject: science
text_zh: 认识物质是多样的，知道物质既有天然存在的也有人工创造的，既有无机物也有有机物；认识依据物质的组成和性质可以对物质进行分类，知道物质可以分为纯净物和混合物、单质和化合物等；知道物质具有独特的物理性质和化学性质，同类物质在性质上具有一定的相似性；知道物质具有广泛的应用价值，物质的性质决定用途。
text_en: Recognize that substances are diverse: know that substances include both naturally occurring and artificially created ones, and both inorganic and organic ones; recognize that substances can be classified according to their composition and properties, and know that substances can be divided into pure substances and mixtures, elements and compounds, and so on; know that substances have distinctive physical and chemical properties, that substances of the same kind are similar in properties to a certain extent, and that substances have wide application value, with the properties of a substance determining its uses.

subject: science
text_zh: 了解空气的主要成分；通过实验探究认识氧气、二氧化碳的主要性质，认识物质的性质与用途的关系；初步学习氧气和二氧化碳的实验室制法，归纳实验室制取气体的一般思路与方法；以自然界中的氧循环和碳循环为例，认识物质在自然界中可以相互转化及其对维持人类生活与生态平衡的意义。
text_en: Understand the main components of air; through experimental inquiry, recognize the main properties of oxygen and carbon dioxide and the relationship between the properties and uses of substances; begin to learn the laboratory preparation of oxygen and carbon dioxide, and summarize the general approach and method for preparing gases in the laboratory; taking the oxygen cycle and carbon cycle in nature as examples, recognize that substances can be interconverted in nature and the significance of this for sustaining human life and ecological balance.

subject: science
text_zh: 认识水的组成，知道水是一种重要的溶剂，了解吸附、沉降、过滤和蒸馏是净化水的常用方法。
text_en: Recognize the composition of water, know that water is an important solvent, and understand that adsorption, sedimentation, filtration and distillation are common methods of purifying water.

subject: science
text_zh: 认识溶解和结晶现象；知道溶液是由溶质和溶剂组成的，具有均一性和稳定性；知道绝大多数物质在溶剂中的溶解是有限度的，了解饱和溶液和溶解度的含义。
text_en: Recognize the phenomena of dissolution and crystallization; know that a solution consists of a solute and a solvent and is homogeneous and stable; know that the dissolution of the vast majority of substances in a solvent is limited, and understand the meaning of saturated solution and solubility.

subject: science
text_zh: 知道溶质质量分数可以表示浓度，认识溶质质量分数的含义，学习计算溶质质量分数和配制一定溶质质量分数的溶液的基本方法，初步感受定量研究的意义；体会溶液在生产生活中的应用价值。
text_en: Know that solute mass fraction can express concentration, recognize its meaning, learn the basic methods of calculating solute mass fraction and preparing solutions with a given solute mass fraction, begin to appreciate the significance of quantitative study, and appreciate the application value of solutions in production and daily life.

subject: science
text_zh: 知道大多数金属在自然界中是以金属矿物形式存在的，体会化学方法在金属治炼中的重要性；知道金属具有一些共同的物理性质，通过实验探究等活动认识常见金属的主要化学性质及金属活动性顺序。
text_en: Know that most metals occur in nature as metal minerals, and appreciate the importance of chemical methods in metal smelting; know that metals share some common physical properties, and through activities such as experimental inquiry recognize the main chemical properties of common metals and the metal activity series.

subject: science
text_zh: 知道在金属中加入其他元素形成合金可以改变金属材料的性能；了解金属、金属材料在生产生活和社会发展中的重要作用；以铁生锈为例，了解防止金属腐蚀的常用方法；了解废弃金属对环境的影响及金属回收再利用的价值。
text_en: Know that adding other elements to a metal to form an alloy can change the properties of the metallic material; understand the important role of metals and metallic materials in production, daily life and social development; taking rusting of iron as an example, understand common methods of preventing metal corrosion; understand the environmental impact of discarded metals and the value of metal recycling and reuse.

subject: science
text_zh: 以盐酸、硫酸、氢氧化钠和氢氧化钙为例，通过实验探究认识酸、碱的主要性质和用途；了解检验溶液酸碱性的基本方法，知道酸碱性对人体健康和农作物生长的影响；了解食盐、纯碱、小苏打和碳酸钙等盐在日常生活中的应用；知道一些常用化肥及其在农业生产中的作用。
text_en: Taking hydrochloric acid, sulfuric acid, sodium hydroxide and calcium hydroxide as examples, recognize through experimental inquiry the main properties and uses of acids and bases; understand basic methods of testing the acidity or alkalinity of solutions, and know the effects of acidity and alkalinity on human health and crop growth; understand the everyday applications of salts such as table salt, soda ash, baking soda and calcium carbonate; know some common chemical fertilizers and their roles in agricultural production.

subject: science
topic_zh: 2.3 认识物质性质的思路与方法
topic_en: 2.3 Approaches and Methods for Understanding the Properties of Matter
text_zh: 了解物质性质包括物理性质和化学性质，知道可以从物质的存在、组成、变化和用途等视角认识物质的性质。
text_en: Understand that the properties of substances include physical properties and chemical properties, and know that the properties of substances can be understood from perspectives such as their occurrence, composition, changes and uses.

subject: science
topic_zh: 2.3 认识物质性质的思路与方法
topic_en: 2.3 Approaches and Methods for Understanding the Properties of Matter
text_zh: 知道可以通过物质类别认识具体物质的性质，了解通过物质的共性和差异性认识一类物质性质的方法。
text_en: Know that the properties of specific substances can be understood through the category to which they belong, and understand the method of understanding the properties of a class of substances through their commonalities and differences.

subject: science
topic_zh: 2.3 认识物质性质的思路与方法
topic_en: 2.3 Approaches and Methods for Understanding the Properties of Matter
text_zh: 了解观察、实验，以及对事实进行归纳概括、分析解释等认识物质性质的基本方法。
text_en: Understand the basic methods of understanding the properties of substances, such as observation, experiment, and inductive generalization, analysis and interpretation of facts.

subject: science
topic_zh: 2.4 物质性质的广泛应用及化学品的合理使用
topic_en: 2.4 Wide Applications of the Properties of Matter and the Rational Use of Chemicals
text_zh: 认识物质性质在生活、生产、科技发展等方面的广泛应用，体会科学地利用物质性质对提高人们的生活质量具有重要作用。
text_en: Recognize the wide application of the properties of substances in daily life, production and the development of science and technology, and appreciate that the scientific use of the properties of substances plays an important role in improving people's quality of life.

subject: science
topic_zh: 2.4 物质性质的广泛应用及化学品的合理使用
topic_en: 2.4 Wide Applications of the Properties of Matter and the Rational Use of Chemicals
text_zh: 结合实例体会化学品的保存、选择和使用与物质性质的重要关系，认识合理使用化学品对保护环境的重要意义，形成合理使用化学品的意识。
text_en: Using examples, appreciate the important relationship between the storage, selection and use of chemicals and the properties of substances, recognize the significance of the rational use of chemicals for protecting the environment, and form an awareness of using chemicals rationally.

subject: science
topic_zh: 2.4 物质性质的广泛应用及化学品的合理使用
topic_en: 2.4 Wide Applications of the Properties of Matter and the Rational Use of Chemicals
text_zh: 认识空气、水、金属矿物是宝贵的自然资源，形成保护和节约资源的可持续发展意识与社会责任。
text_en: Recognize that air, water and metal minerals are precious natural resources, and form a sense of sustainable development and social responsibility for protecting and conserving resources.

subject: science
topic_zh: 2.5 学生必做实验及实践活动
topic_en: 2.5 Required Student Experiments and Practical Activities
text_zh: （1）粗盐中难溶性杂质的去除。
text_en: (1) Removal of insoluble impurities from crude salt.

subject: science
topic_zh: 2.5 学生必做实验及实践活动
topic_en: 2.5 Required Student Experiments and Practical Activities
text_zh: （2）氧气的实验室制取与性质。
text_en: (2) Laboratory preparation and properties of oxygen.

subject: science
topic_zh: 2.5 学生必做实验及实践活动
topic_en: 2.5 Required Student Experiments and Practical Activities
text_zh: （3）二氧化碳的实验室制取与性质。
text_en: (3) Laboratory preparation and properties of carbon dioxide.

subject: science
topic_zh: 2.5 学生必做实验及实践活动
topic_en: 2.5 Required Student Experiments and Practical Activities
text_zh: （4）常见金属的物理性质和化学性质。
text_en: (4) Physical and chemical properties of common metals.

subject: science
topic_zh: 2.5 学生必做实验及实践活动
topic_en: 2.5 Required Student Experiments and Practical Activities
text_zh: （5）常见酸、碱的化学性质。
text_en: (5) Chemical properties of common acids and bases.

subject: science
topic_zh: 2.5 学生必做实验及实践活动
topic_en: 2.5 Required Student Experiments and Practical Activities
text_zh: （6）一定溶质质量分数的氯化钠溶液的配制。
text_en: (6) Preparation of a sodium chloride solution with a given solute mass fraction.

subject: science
topic_zh: 2.5 学生必做实验及实践活动
topic_en: 2.5 Required Student Experiments and Practical Activities
text_zh: （7）跨学科实践活动（从学习主题5中选择）。
text_en: (7) Interdisciplinary practical activities (chosen from Learning Theme 5).

subject: science
text_zh: 初步形成基于元素和分子、原子认识物质及其变化的视角，建立认识物质的宏观和微观视角之间的关联，知道物质的性质与组成、结构有关。
text_en: Begin to form a perspective of understanding substances and their changes in terms of elements, molecules and atoms; establish connections between the macroscopic and microscopic perspectives on substances; know that the properties of a substance are related to its composition and structure.

subject: science
text_zh: 认识物质是由元素组成的，知道质子数相同的一类原子属于同种元素，了解在化学反应中元素的种类是不变的，初步认识元素周期表。
text_en: Recognize that substances are composed of elements, know that a class of atoms with the same number of protons belongs to the same element, understand that the kinds of elements remain unchanged in chemical reactions, and gain a preliminary acquaintance with the periodic table of the elements.

subject: science
text_zh: 知道物质是由分子、原子等微观粒子构成的；认识原子是由原子核和核外电子构成的；知道原子可以结合成分子，也可以转变为离子。
text_en: Know that substances are composed of microscopic particles such as molecules and atoms; recognize that an atom is composed of a nucleus and extranuclear electrons; know that atoms can combine into molecules and can also be converted into ions.

subject: science
topic_en: 3.2.3 Representation of the Composition of Matter
text_zh: 知道可以用符号表示物质的组成，认识表示分子、原子、离子的符号，知道常见元素的化合价，学习用化学式表示常见物质组成的方法，认识相对原子质量、相对分子质量的含义及应用。
text_en: Know that the composition of substances can be represented by symbols; recognize the symbols representing molecules, atoms and ions; know the valences of common elements; learn to use chemical formulas to represent the composition of common substances; recognize the meaning and application of relative atomic mass and relative molecular mass.

subject: science
topic_zh: 3.3 认识物质的组成与结构的思路与方法
topic_en: 3.3 Approaches and Methods for Understanding the Composition and Structure of Matter
text_zh: 通过科学史实体会科学家探索物质的组成与结构的智慧，知道可以通过实验、想象、推理、假说、模型等方法探索物质的结构；初步学习利用物质的性质和化学反应探究物质组成的基本思路与方法。
text_en: Through historical facts of science, appreciate scientists' wisdom in exploring the composition and structure of substances; know that the structure of substances can be explored through methods such as experiment, imagination, reasoning, hypothesis and models; begin to learn the basic approaches and methods of using the properties of substances and chemical reactions to investigate the composition of substances.

subject: science
topic_zh: 3.4 研究物质的组成与结构的意义
topic_en: 3.4 Significance of Studying the Composition and Structure of Matter
text_zh: 了解人类对物质的组成与结构的探索是不断发展的，初步认识物质的组成、结构与性质之间的关系，了解研究物质的组成与结构对认识和创造物质的重要意义。
text_en: Understand that humankind's exploration of the composition and structure of substances is continually developing, begin to recognize the relationships among the composition, structure and properties of substances, and understand the importance of studying the composition and structure of substances for understanding and creating substances.

subject: science
topic_zh: 3.5 学生必做实验及实践活动
topic_en: 3.5 Required Student Experiments and Practical Activities
text_zh: （1）水的组成及变化的探究。
text_en: (1) Investigation of the composition and changes of water.

subject: science
topic_zh: 3.5 学生必做实验及实践活动
topic_en: 3.5 Required Student Experiments and Practical Activities
text_zh: （2）跨学科实践活动（从学习主题5中选择）。
text_en: (2) Interdisciplinary practical activities (chosen from Learning Theme 5).

subject: science
text_zh: 知道物质是在不断变化的，物质变化分为物理变化和化学变化；认识物质的变化过程伴随着能量变化，在一定条件下通过化学反应可以实现物质转化，化学反应中的各物质间存在定量关系，初步形成变化观。
text_en: Know that substances are constantly changing and that changes in substances are divided into physical changes and chemical changes; recognize that changes in substances are accompanied by energy changes, that under certain conditions substances can be converted through chemical reactions, and that there are quantitative relationships among the substances in a chemical reaction; begin to form a view of change.

subject: science
topic_zh: 4.2.1 化学变化的特征及化学反应的基本类型
topic_en: 4.2.1 Characteristics of Chemical Changes and Basic Types of Chemical Reactions
text_zh: 认识化学变化是产生新物质的过程，知道化学变化常伴随生成沉淀、产生气体、发生颜色变化、发光，以及吸热或放热等现象。
text_en: Recognize that a chemical change is a process that produces new substances, and know that chemical changes are often accompanied by phenomena such as the formation of precipitates, the production of gas, color changes, the emission of light, and the absorption or release of heat.

subject: science
topic_zh: 4.2.1 化学变化的特征及化学反应的基本类型
topic_en: 4.2.1 Characteristics of Chemical Changes and Basic Types of Chemical Reactions
text_zh: 理解化学反应的本质是原子的重新组合，化学反应前后，原子的种类和数量不变，分子的种类发生改变；认识常见的化合反应、分解反应、置换反应和复分解反应及简单应用。
text_en: Understand that the essence of a chemical reaction is the rearrangement of atoms, that before and after a chemical reaction the kinds and numbers of atoms remain unchanged while the kinds of molecules change; recognize common combination reactions, decomposition reactions, displacement reactions and double decomposition reactions and their simple applications.

subject: science
topic_zh: 4.2.1 化学变化的特征及化学反应的基本类型
topic_en: 4.2.1 Characteristics of Chemical Changes and Basic Types of Chemical Reactions
text_zh: 了解化学反应需要一定的条件，知道催化剂对化学反应的重要作用；通过实验探究认识燃烧的条件，理解燃烧和灭火的原理及其在生活中的应用，初步体会调控化学反应的重要意义。
text_en: Understand that chemical reactions require certain conditions, and know the important role of catalysts in chemical reactions; through experimental inquiry recognize the conditions for combustion, understand the principles of combustion and fire extinguishing and their applications in daily life, and begin to appreciate the importance of regulating chemical reactions.

subject: science
topic_zh: 4.2.2 化学反应的定量关系与质量守恒定律
topic_en: 4.2.2 Quantitative Relationships in Chemical Reactions and the Law of Conservation of Mass
text_zh: 认识化学反应中的各物质间存在定量关系，化学反应遵守质量守恒定律；理解质量守恒定律的微观本质。
text_en: Recognize that there are quantitative relationships among the substances in a chemical reaction and that chemical reactions obey the law of conservation of mass; understand the microscopic essence of the law of conservation of mass.

subject: science
topic_zh: 4.3 认识化学反应的思路与方法
topic_en: 4.3 Approaches and Methods for Understanding Chemical Reactions
text_zh: 学习从物质变化、能量变化、反应条件、反应现象、反应类型和元素守恒等视角认识化学反应，初步形成认识化学反应的系统思维意识。
text_en: Learn to understand chemical reactions from perspectives such as changes in substances, energy changes, reaction conditions, reaction phenomena, reaction types and conservation of elements, and begin to form a systematic awareness of thinking about chemical reactions.

subject: science
topic_zh: 4.3 认识化学反应的思路与方法
topic_en: 4.3 Approaches and Methods for Understanding Chemical Reactions
text_zh: 学习利用质量关系、比例关系定量认识化学反应，认识定量研究对化学科学发展的重大作用。
text_en: Learn to understand chemical reactions quantitatively using mass relationships and proportional relationships, and recognize the great role of quantitative study in the development of chemistry.

subject: science
topic_zh: 4.3 认识化学反应的思路与方法
topic_en: 4.3 Approaches and Methods for Understanding Chemical Reactions
text_zh: 初步形成利用化学反应探究物质性质和组成、解决物质制备和检验等实际问题的思路，初步体会化学反应与技术、工程的关系。
text_en: Begin to form approaches to using chemical reactions to investigate the properties and composition of substances and to solve practical problems such as the preparation and testing of substances, and begin to appreciate the relationship between chemical reactions and technology and engineering.

subject: science
topic_zh: 4.4 化学反应的应用价值及合理调控
topic_en: 4.4 Application Value of Chemical Reactions and Their Rational Control
text_zh: 认识化学变化在自然界和生产生活中的广泛存在及重要应用，感受大自然中化学变化的神奇；结合实例体会通过化学反应实现物质转化的意义和价值；欣赏化学反应造福人类的独特价值，学习化学家的创新精神。
text_en: Recognize the wide presence and important applications of chemical changes in nature, production and daily life, and sense the wonder of chemical changes in nature; using examples, appreciate the significance and value of achieving the conversion of substances through chemical reactions; appreciate the unique value of chemical reactions in benefiting humankind, and learn from chemists' spirit of innovation.

subject: science
topic_zh: 4.4 化学反应的应用价值及合理调控
topic_en: 4.4 Application Value of Chemical Reactions and Their Rational Control
text_zh: 结合实例认识合理利用、调控化学反应的重要性，关注产品需求和成本核算，初步树立资源循环使用、绿色环保的发展理念。
text_en: Using examples, recognize the importance of rationally using and regulating chemical reactions, pay attention to product demand and cost accounting, and begin to establish the development concepts of recycling resources and green environmental protection.

subject: science
topic_zh: 4.5 学生必做实验及实践活动
topic_en: 4.5 Required Student Experiments and Practical Activities
text_zh: （2）跨学科实践活动（从学习主题5中选择）。
text_en: (2) Interdisciplinary practical activities (chosen from Learning Theme 5).

subject: science
text_zh: 知道科学和技术有助于解决社会问题，使用科学和技术时要考虑其对社会和环境的影响，理解科学、技术、社会、环境的相互关系；认识化学在解决与资源、能源、材料、环境、人类健康等相关的问题中的作用，体会化学是推动人类社会可持续发展的重要力量，树立建设美丽中国、为全球生态安全作贡献的信念；主动践行节约资源、环境友好的生活方式，树立人与自然和谐共生的科学自然观和绿色发展观。
text_en: Know that science and technology help solve social problems, that their effects on society and the environment must be considered when using them, and understand the interrelationships among science, technology, society and the environment; recognize the role of chemistry in solving problems related to resources, energy, materials, the environment and human health, appreciate that chemistry is an important force promoting the sustainable development of human society, and establish the conviction of building a beautiful China and contributing to global ecological security; actively practice a lifestyle that conserves resources and is environmentally friendly, and establish a scientific view of nature and a view of green development in which humans and nature coexist in harmony.

subject: science
topic_zh: 5.2 化学与资源、能源、材料、环境、健康
topic_en: 5.2 Chemistry and Resources, Energy, Materials, Environment, and Health
text_zh: 结合实例，从物质及其变化的视角，认识资源的综合利用与新能源的开发、材料的科学利用与新材料的研发，理解化学与生态环境保护、医药研制及营养健康的关系；了解酒精、天然气、有机高分子材料等在社会生活中的应用；知道资源开发、能源利用和材料使用可能会对环境产生影响，树立环保意识。
text_en: Using examples, and from the perspective of substances and their changes, recognize the comprehensive utilization of resources and the development of new energy sources, and the scientific use of materials and the development of new materials; understand the relationships between chemistry and ecological environmental protection, drug development, and nutrition and health; understand the applications of alcohol, natural gas, organic polymer materials and the like in social life; know that resource development, energy use and material use may have impacts on the environment, and establish environmental awareness.

subject: science
topic_zh: 5.3 化学、技术、工程融合解决跨学科问题的思路与方法
topic_en: 5.3 Approaches and Methods for Integrating Chemistry, Technology, and Engineering to Solve Interdisciplinary Problems
text_zh: 通过实践活动，初步形成应用元素观、变化观等化学观念和科学探究方法解决问题的思路；认识在解决实际问题时，需要综合运用各学科知识，采用合适的方法和工具，以及系统规划和实施；体会有效使用科学技术，以及合作、协同创新解决问题的重要性。
text_en: Through practical activities, begin to form approaches to solving problems using chemical concepts such as the view of elements and the view of change together with scientific inquiry methods; recognize that solving practical problems requires the integrated use of knowledge from various subjects, the adoption of suitable methods and tools, and systematic planning and implementation; appreciate the importance of using science and technology effectively, and of cooperation and collaborative innovation in solving problems.

subject: science
text_zh: 通过实例分析或参加与化学相关的职业体验活动，认识到应用科学知识解决问题时，应恪守科学伦理；知道国家在生态环境保护，化学品、食品、药品安全等方面颁布了法律法规，增强遵纪守法、自我保护及维护社会安全的意识。
text_en: Through case analysis or participation in chemistry-related career experience activities, recognize that scientific ethics must be observed when applying scientific knowledge to solve problems; know that the state has promulgated laws and regulations on ecological and environmental protection and on the safety of chemicals, food and drugs, and strengthen awareness of abiding by laws and regulations, protecting oneself, and safeguarding social security.

subject: science
text_zh: 知道现代科学技术的开发和应用可能会引起与生态环境、伦理道德、经济发展等相关的问题；知道人类生存与发展会面临来自环境、能源、资源、健康和公共卫生等方面的危机与不确定性挑战；通过参与社会性科学议题的探讨活动，体会以理性、积极的态度和系统、创新的思维应对挑战的重要性。
text_en: Know that the development and application of modern science and technology may give rise to problems related to the ecological environment, ethics and morality, economic development and so on; know that human survival and development face crises and uncertain challenges from the environment, energy, resources, health and public health; through participating in discussions of socio-scientific issues, appreciate the importance of responding to challenges with a rational and positive attitude and with systematic and innovative thinking.

subject: science
text_zh: （1）微型空气质量“检测站”的组装与使用。
text_en: (1) Assembly and use of a miniature air quality "monitoring station".

subject: science
text_zh: （2）基于特定需求设计和制作简易供氧器。
text_en: (2) Designing and making a simple oxygen supply device based on specific needs.

subject: science
text_zh: （3）水质检测及自制净水器。
text_en: (3) Water quality testing and making a homemade water purifier.

subject: science
text_zh: （4）基于碳中和理念设计低碳行动方案。
text_en: (4) Designing a low-carbon action plan based on the concept of carbon neutrality.

subject: science
text_zh: （5）垃圾的分类与回收利用。
text_en: (5) Sorting, recycling and reuse of waste.

subject: science
text_zh: （6）探究土壤酸碱性对植物生长的影响。
text_en: (6) Investigating the effect of soil acidity or alkalinity on plant growth.

subject: science
text_zh: （7）海洋资源的综合利用与制盐。
text_en: (7) Comprehensive utilization of marine resources and salt production.

subject: science
text_zh: （8）制作模型并展示科学家探索物质组成与结构的历程。
text_en: (8) Making models and presenting the history of scientists' exploration of the composition and structure of substances.

subject: science
text_zh: （9）调查家用燃料的变迁与合理使用。
text_en: (9) Investigating changes in household fuels and their rational use.

subject: science
text_zh: （10）调查我国航天科技领域中新型材料、新型能源的应用。
text_en: (10) Investigating the application of new materials and new energy sources in China's aerospace science and technology.

subject: science
text_zh: 注：跨学科实践活动原则上从以上10项中选择，所用课时不少于本学科总课时的10%。
text_en: Note: Interdisciplinary practical activities are in principle chosen from the 10 items above, taking no less than 10% of the total class hours of the subject.

subject: science
area_zh: 生物体的结构层次|概念1生物体具有一定的结构层次，能够完成各项生命活动
topic_zh: 细胞是生物体结构和功能的基本单位
area_en: Levels of Organization of Organisms | Concept 1: Organisms have certain levels of structural organization and can carry out all life activities
topic_en: The cell is the basic unit of structure and function of organisms
text_zh: 一些生物由单细胞构成，一些生物由多细胞组成
text_en: Some organisms are composed of a single cell; others are composed of many cells.

subject: science
area_zh: 生物体的结构层次|概念1生物体具有一定的结构层次，能够完成各项生命活动
topic_zh: 细胞是生物体结构和功能的基本单位
area_en: Levels of Organization of Organisms | Concept 1: Organisms have certain levels of structural organization and can carry out all life activities
topic_en: The cell is the basic unit of structure and function of organisms
text_zh: 动物细胞、植物细胞都具有细胞膜、细胞质、细胞核等结构
text_en: Animal cells and plant cells all have structures such as a cell membrane, cytoplasm and a nucleus.

subject: science
area_zh: 生物体的结构层次|概念1生物体具有一定的结构层次，能够完成各项生命活动
topic_zh: 细胞是生物体结构和功能的基本单位
area_en: Levels of Organization of Organisms | Concept 1: Organisms have certain levels of structural organization and can carry out all life activities

area_en: Genetics and Evolution | Concept 7: Genetic information controls the traits of organisms and is passed from parents to offspring
topic_en: Organisms produce offspring through sexual or asexual reproduction
text_zh: 睾丸和卵巢可分别产生精子和卵细胞，卵细胞受精后形成的受精卵能够发育成新个体
text_en: The testes and ovaries produce sperm and egg cells respectively; the fertilized egg formed after an egg cell is fertilized can develop into a new individual.

subject: science
area_zh: 遗传与进化|概念7遗传信息控制生物性状，并由亲代传递给子代
topic_zh: 生物通过有性生殖或无性生殖产生后代

topic_en: Organisms produce offspring through sexual or asexual reproduction
text_zh: 生物可以通过有性生殖或无性生殖繁殖后代
text_en: Organisms can reproduce offspring by sexual reproduction or asexual reproduction.

subject: science
area_zh: 遗传与进化|概念7遗传信息控制生物性状，并由亲代传递给子代
topic_zh: 生物体的性状主要由基因控制
area_en: Genetics and Evolution | Concept 7: Genetic information controls the traits of organisms and is passed from parents to offspring
topic_en: The traits of organisms are mainly controlled by genes
text_zh: 基因是包含遗传信息的DNA片段，随配子由亲代传给子代
text_en: A gene is a segment of DNA that contains genetic information and is passed from parents to offspring through gametes.

subject: science
area_zh: 遗传与进化|概念7遗传信息控制生物性状，并由亲代传递给子代
topic_zh: 生物体的性状主要由基因控制
area_en: Genetics and Evolution | Concept 7: Genetic information controls the traits of organisms and is passed from parents to offspring
topic_en: The traits of organisms are mainly controlled by genes
text_zh: 基因位于染色体上，人的性别是由性染色体的组成决定的
text_en: Genes are located on chromosomes; a person's sex is determined by the composition of the sex chromosomes.

subject: science
area_zh: 遗传与进化|概念7遗传信息控制生物性状，并由亲代传递给子代
topic_zh: 生物体的性状主要由基因控制
area_en: Genetics and Evolution | Concept 7: Genetic information controls the traits of organisms and is passed from parents to offspring
topic_en: The traits of organisms are mainly controlled by genes
text_zh: 生物的性状是由基因组成和环境共同决定的
text_en: The traits of an organism are determined jointly by its genetic makeup (genes) and the environment.

subject: science
area_zh: 遗传与进化|概念7遗传信息控制生物性状，并由亲代传递给子代
topic_zh: 生物体的性状主要由基因控制
area_en: Genetics and Evolution | Concept 7: Genetic information controls the traits of organisms and is passed from parents to offspring
topic_en: The traits of organisms are mainly controlled by genes
text_zh: 遗传信息发生改变可以引起生物变异
text_en: Changes in genetic information can cause variation in organisms.

subject: science
area_zh: 遗传与进化|概念7遗传信息控制生物性状，并由亲代传递给子代
topic_zh: 生物体的性状主要由基因控制
area_en: Genetics and Evolution | Concept 7: Genetic information controls the traits of organisms and is passed from parents to offspring
topic_en: The traits of organisms are mainly controlled by genes
text_zh: 杂交育种、转基因等技术促进了农业发展
text_en: Technologies such as cross breeding and transgenics have promoted agricultural development.

subject: science
area_zh: 遗传与进化|概念8地球上现存的生物来自共同祖先，是长期进化的结果
topic_zh: 地球上现存的生物具有共同祖先
area_en: Genetics and Evolution | Concept 8: Living organisms on Earth descend from a common ancestor and are the result of long-term evolution
topic_en: All living organisms on Earth share a common ancestor
text_zh: 生命最有可能是在原始海洋中形成的
text_en: Life most probably formed in the primitive ocean.

subject: science
area_zh: 遗传与进化|概念8地球上现存的生物来自共同祖先，是长期进化的结果
topic_zh: 地球上现存的生物具有共同祖先
area_en: Genetics and Evolution | Concept 8: Living organisms on Earth descend from a common ancestor and are the result of long-term evolution
topic_en: All living organisms on Earth share a common ancestor
text_zh: 化石记录是生物进化的直接证据
text_en: The fossil record is direct evidence of biological evolution.

subject: science
area_zh: 遗传与进化|概念8地球上现存的生物来自共同祖先，是长期进化的结果
topic_zh: 多种多样的生物是经过自然选择长期进化的结果
area_en: Genetics and Evolution | Concept 8: Living organisms on Earth descend from a common ancestor and are the result of long-term evolution
topic_en: The diversity of organisms is the result of long-term evolution through natural selection
text_zh: 遗传变异和环境因素的共同作用导致了生物的进化
text_en: The combined action of genetic variation and environmental factors has driven the evolution of organisms.

subject: science
area_zh: 遗传与进化|概念8地球上现存的生物来自共同祖先，是长期进化的结果
topic_zh: 多种多样的生物是经过自然选择长期进化的结果
area_en: Genetics and Evolution | Concept 8: Living organisms on Earth descend from a common ancestor and are the result of long-term evolution
topic_en: The diversity of organisms is the result of long-term evolution through natural selection
text_zh: 生物的进化总体上呈现出由简单到复杂、由水生到陆生的趋势
text_en: Overall, biological evolution shows a trend from simple to complex and from aquatic to terrestrial.

subject: science
area_zh: 遗传与进化|概念8地球上现存的生物来自共同祖先，是长期进化的结果
topic_zh: 多种多样的生物是经过自然选择长期进化的结果
area_en: Genetics and Evolution | Concept 8: Living organisms on Earth descend from a common ancestor and are the result of long-term evolution
topic_en: The diversity of organisms is the result of long-term evolution through natural selection
text_zh: 人类和现代类人猿都是由古猿进化而来的
text_en: Humans and modern apes both evolved from ancient apes.

subject: ela
text_zh: 喜欢学习汉字，有主动识字、写字的愿望。认识常用汉字1600个左右，其中800个左右会写。
text_en: Enjoy learning Chinese characters and have the desire to take the initiative in recognizing and writing them. Recognize about 1,600 commonly used characters, of which about 800 can be written.

subject: ela
text_zh: 学会汉语拼音。能读准声母、韵母、声调和整体认读音节。能准确地拼读音节，正确书写声母、韵母和音节。认识大写字母，熟记《汉语拼音字母表》。
text_en: Learn Hanyu Pinyin. Be able to read initials, finals, tones, and whole-recognition syllables accurately. Be able to blend syllables accurately, and correctly write initials, finals, and syllables. Recognize the capital letters and know the Hanyu Pinyin alphabet by heart.

subject: ela
text_zh: 掌握汉字的基本笔画和常用的偏旁部首，能按基本的笔顺规则用硬笔写字，注意间架结构，初步感受汉字的形体美。努力养成良好的写字习惯，写字姿势正确，书写规范、端正、整洁。
text_en: Master the basic strokes of Chinese characters and the commonly used radicals; be able to write with a hard-tipped pen following the basic stroke-order rules, paying attention to the structure and arrangement of components, and begin to appreciate the beauty of character forms. Work at forming good writing habits: correct writing posture, and writing that is standard, upright, and neat.

subject: ela
text_zh: 学习独立识字。能借助汉语拼音认读汉字，学会用音序检字法和部首检字法查字典。
text_en: Learn to recognize characters independently. Be able to read characters aloud with the help of Hanyu Pinyin, and learn to look characters up in a dictionary by the alphabetical-order method and the radical method.

subject: ela
text_zh: 喜欢阅读，感受阅读的乐趣。学习用普通话正确、流利、有感情地朗读课文。学习默读。
text_en: Enjoy reading and feel the pleasure of reading. Learn to read texts aloud in Putonghua correctly, fluently, and with feeling. Learn to read silently.

subject: ela
text_zh: 结合上下文和生活实际了解课文中词句的意思，在阅读中积累词语。认识课文中出现的常用标点符号，在阅读中体会句号、问号、感叹号所表达的不同语气。借助读物中的图画阅读。
text_en: Understand the meaning of words and sentences in a text with the help of context and real-life experience, and build up vocabulary through reading. Recognize the common punctuation marks that appear in texts, and appreciate in reading the different tones expressed by the period, question mark, and exclamation mark. Read with the help of pictures in reading materials.

subject: ela
text_zh: 阅读浅近的童话、寓言、故事，向往美好的情境，关心自然和生命，对感兴趣的人物和事件有自己的感受和想法，并乐于与他人交流。诵读儿歌、儿童诗和浅近的古诗，展开想象，获得初步的情感体验，感受语言的优美。
text_en: Read simple fairy tales, fables, and stories; aspire to beautiful situations, care about nature and life, have one's own feelings and thoughts about characters and events of interest, and be glad to share them with others. Recite children's rhymes, children's poems, and simple classical poems, using imagination to gain initial emotional experiences and to feel the beauty of language.

subject: ela
text_zh: 尝试阅读整本书，用自己喜欢的方式向他人介绍读过的书。养成爱护图书的习惯。
text_en: Try reading whole books, and introduce books one has read to others in a way one likes. Develop the habit of taking care of books.

subject: ela
text_zh: 积累自己喜欢的成语和格言警句。背诵优秀诗文50篇（段）。课外阅读总量不少于5万字。
text_en: Accumulate idioms and maxims one likes. Recite 50 excellent poems and prose passages (or excerpts). Total extracurricular reading of no fewer than 50,000 characters.

subject: ela
text_zh: 学说普通话，逐步养成说普通话的习惯，有表达交流的自信心。
text_en: Learn to speak Putonghua, gradually develop the habit of speaking Putonghua, and have confidence in expressing oneself and communicating.

subject: ela
text_zh: 能认真听他人讲话，努力了解讲话的主要内容。听故事、看影视作品，能复述大意和自己感兴趣的情节。能较完整地讲述小故事，能简要讲述自己感兴趣的见闻。与他人交谈，态度自然大方，有礼貌。积极参加讨论，敢于发表自己的意见。
text_en: Be able to listen attentively when others speak and strive to understand the main content of what is said. When listening to stories or watching films and television works, be able to retell the gist and the episodes one finds interesting. Be able to tell short stories fairly completely and briefly recount interesting things one has seen and heard. When conversing with others, be natural, at ease, and polite. Take an active part in discussions and dare to express one's own opinions.

subject: ela
text_zh: 对写话有兴趣，留心周围事物，写自己想说的话，写想象中的事物。在写话中乐于运用阅读和生活中学到的词语。
text_en: Be interested in writing sentences and short passages (xiehua); pay attention to the things around one, and write what one wants to say and write about imagined things. Be glad to use in writing the words learned from reading and from life.

subject: ela
text_zh: 根据表达的需要，学习使用逗号、句号、问号、感叹号。
text_en: According to the needs of expression, learn to use the comma, period, question mark, and exclamation mark.

subject: ela
text_zh: 观察字形，体会汉字部件之间的关系。梳理学过的字，感知汉字与生活的联系。
text_en: Observe the forms of characters and appreciate the relationships among character components. Organize the characters learned, and perceive the connections between Chinese characters and life.

subject: ela
text_zh: 观察大白然，热心参加校园、社区活动，积累活动体验。结三、课程日标10合语文学习，用口头或图文等方式整理、表达自己在活动中的见闻和想法。
text_en: Observe nature, take an enthusiastic part in school and community activities, and accumulate experience from activities. Integrating with Chinese language learning, organize and express one's observations and thoughts from activities orally or through text and pictures.

subject: ela
text_zh: 对周围事物有好奇心，能就感兴趣的内容提出问题，结合其他学科的学习和生活经验交流讨论，尝试提出自己的看法。在落实以上要求过程中，注重引导学生关注中华优秀传统文化在日常生活中的表现，初步感受中华优秀传统文化的重要价值；初步懂得幸福生活是革命前辈浴血奋战、艰苦奋斗换来的，激发对革命领袖、革命家、英雄人物的崇敬之情。
text_en: Be curious about the things around one; be able to raise questions about content of interest, discuss them in connection with learning in other subjects and life experience, and try to put forward one's own views. In carrying out the above requirements, give emphasis to guiding students to notice how excellent traditional Chinese culture shows itself in daily life and to begin to appreciate its important value; begin to understand that a happy life was won through the bloody struggle and hard work of revolutionary forebears, and arouse admiration for revolutionary leaders, revolutionaries, and heroes.

subject: ela
text_zh: 对学习汉字有浓厚的兴趣，养成主动识字的习惯。累计认识常用汉字2500个左右，其中1600个左右会写。有初步的独立识字能力。能用音序检字法和部首检字法查字典、词典。
text_en: Have a strong interest in learning Chinese characters and form the habit of recognizing characters on one's own initiative. Cumulatively recognize about 2,500 commonly used characters, of which about 1,600 can be written. Have an initial ability to recognize characters independently. Be able to look up characters in dictionaries and word dictionaries by the alphabetical-order method and the radical method.

subject: ela
text_zh: 写字姿势正确，养成良好的书写习惯。能用硬笔熟练地书写正楷字，做到规范、端正、整洁。用毛笔临摹正楷字帖，感受汉字的书写特点和形体美。
text_en: Have correct writing posture and form good writing habits. Be able to write regular script (kaishu) skillfully with a hard-tipped pen, so that it is standard, upright, and neat. Copy regular-script model books with a brush, and appreciate the characteristics of writing Chinese characters and the beauty of their forms.

subject: ela
text_zh: 能感知常用汉字形、音、义之间的联系，初步建立汉字与生活中事物、行为的联系，初步感受汉字的文化内涵。
text_en: Be able to perceive the connections among the form, sound, and meaning of commonly used characters, begin to link characters with things and actions in life, and begin to appreciate the cultural connotations of Chinese characters.

subject: ela
text_zh: 用普通话正确、流利、有感情地朗读课文。初步学会默读，做到不出声，不指读。学习略读，粗知文章大意。
text_en: Read texts aloud in Putonghua correctly, fluently, and with feeling. Begin to learn to read silently, without making a sound and without pointing at the words. Learn to skim, getting a rough idea of the gist of an article.

subject: ela
text_zh: 能联系上下文，理解词句的意思，体会课文中关键词句表达情意的作用。能借助字典、词典和生活积累，理解生词的意义。在理解语句的过程中，体会句号与逗号的不同用法，了解冒号、引号的一般用法。
text_en: Be able to understand the meaning of words and sentences in connection with context, and appreciate the role of key words and sentences in a text in conveying feeling. Be able to understand the meaning of new words with the help of dictionaries, word dictionaries, and accumulated life experience. In the process of understanding sentences, appreciate the different uses of the period and the comma, and understand the general uses of the colon and quotation marks.

subject: ela
text_zh: 能初步把握文章的主要内容，体会文章表达的思想感情。学习圈点、批注等阅读方法。能对课文中不理解的地方提出疑问，乐于与他人讨论交流。
text_en: Be able to begin to grasp the main content of an article and appreciate the thoughts and feelings it expresses. Learn reading methods such as circling, underlining, and annotating. Be able to raise questions about parts of a text one does not understand, and be glad to discuss and exchange views with others.

subject: ela
text_zh: 能复述叙事性作品的大意，初步感受作品中生动的形象和优美的语言，关心作品中人物的命运和喜怒哀乐，与他人交流自己的阅读感受。诵读优秀诗文，注意在诵读过程中体验情感，展开想象，领悟诗文大意。
text_en: Be able to retell the gist of narrative works, begin to feel the vivid images and beautiful language in them, care about the fate, joys, and sorrows of the characters, and share one's reading impressions with others. Recite excellent poems and prose, taking care while reciting to experience the emotions, use imagination, and grasp the general meaning of the work.

subject: ela
text_zh: 阅读整本书，初步理解主要内容，主动和同学分享自己的阅读感受。
text_en: Read whole books, begin to understand their main content, and take the initiative to share one's reading impressions with classmates.

subject: ela
text_zh: 积累课文中的优美词语、精彩句段，以及在课外阅读和生活中获得的语言材料。背诵优秀诗文50篇（段）。养成读书看报的习惯，收藏图书资料，乐于与同学交流。课外阅读总量不少于40万字。
text_en: Accumulate beautiful words and fine sentences and passages from texts, as well as language material gained from extracurricular reading and from life. Recite 50 excellent poems and prose passages (or excerpts). Develop the habit of reading books and newspapers, collect books and reference materials, and be glad to exchange views with classmates. Total extracurricular reading of no fewer than 400,000 characters.

subject: ela
text_zh: 乐于用口头、书面的方式与人交流沟通，愿意与他人分享，增强表达的自信心。
text_en: Be glad to communicate with others orally and in writing, be willing to share with others, and strengthen confidence in expressing oneself.

subject: ela
text_zh: 能用普通话交谈，学会认真倾听，听人说话时能把握主要内容，并能简要转述。能就不理解的地方向人请教，就不同的意见与人商讨。
text_en: Be able to converse in Putonghua and learn to listen attentively; when listening to others, be able to grasp the main content and give a brief restatement. Be able to ask others for advice about what one does not understand and discuss differing views with others.

subject: ela
text_zh: 能清楚明白地讲述见闻，说出自己的感受和想法。讲述故事力求具体生动。能主动参与日常生活中的文化活动，根据不同的场合，尝试运用合适的音量和语气与他人交流，有礼貌地请教、回应。
text_en: Be able to recount what one has seen and heard clearly and plainly, and state one's own feelings and thoughts. Strive to tell stories concretely and vividly. Take the initiative to take part in cultural activities in daily life; according to different occasions, try to use appropriate volume and tone in communicating with others, and ask for advice and respond politely.

subject: ela
text_zh: 观察周围世界，能不拘形式地写下自己的见闻、感受和想象，注意把自己觉得新奇有趣或印象最深、最受感动的内容写清楚。能用便条、简短的书信等进行交流。尝试在习作中运用自己平时积累的语言材料，特别是有新鲜感的词句。
text_en: Observe the world around one and be able to write down one's observations, feelings, and imaginings in any form; take care to write clearly the content one finds novel and interesting, or most memorable and moving. Be able to communicate through notes and short letters. Try to use in one's writing the language material one has accumulated, especially fresh words and sentences.

subject: ela
text_zh: 学习修改习作中有明显错误的词句。根据表达的需要，正确三、课程日标1』使用冒号、引号等标点符号。课内习作每学年16次左右。
text_en: Learn to revise obviously wrong words and sentences in one's writing. According to the needs of expression, correctly use punctuation marks such as the colon and quotation marks. In-class composition about 16 times per school year.

subject: ela
text_zh: 尝试分类整理学过的字词。尝试发现所学汉字形、音、义和书写的特点，帮助自己识字、写字。
text_en: Try to sort and organize the characters and words learned. Try to discover the features of the form, sound, meaning, and writing of the characters learned, to help one in recognizing and writing characters.

subject: ela
text_zh: 学习组织有趣味的语文实践活动，在活动中学习语文，学会合作。结合语文学习，观察大自然，观察社会，积极思考，运用书面或口头方式，并可尝试用表格、图像、音频等多种媒介，呈现自己的观察与探究所得。
text_en: Learn to organize interesting Chinese language practice activities, learn Chinese through activities, and learn to cooperate. Integrating with Chinese language learning, observe nature and society and think actively, and present the results of one's observation and inquiry in written or oral form, and also try using various media such as tables, images, and audio.

subject: ela
text_zh: 能提出学习和生活中的问题，有目的地搜集资料，共同讨论，尝试运用语文并结合其他学科知识解决问题。在落实以上要求过程中，注重感悟国家通用语言文字的文化内涵，初步认识中华优秀传统文化蕴含的思想和智慧；感悟革命英雄、模范人物的爱国主义情怀和高尚品质，激发向英雄模范学习的意愿和行动，培养对中国共产党和中华人民共和国的朴素情感，增强民族自豪感。
text_en: Be able to raise questions from learning and life, collect materials purposefully, discuss together, and try to solve problems using Chinese language together with knowledge from other subjects. In carrying out the above requirements, give emphasis to appreciating the cultural connotations of the national common language and script, and begin to recognize the thought and wisdom contained in excellent traditional Chinese culture; appreciate the patriotic feelings and noble qualities of revolutionary heroes and model figures, arouse the willingness to learn from them and act on it, foster simple feelings for the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and strengthen national pride.

subject: ela
text_zh: 有较强的独立识字能力。累计认识常用汉字3000个左右，其中2500个左右会写。感受汉字的构字组词特点，体会汉字蕴含的智慧。
text_en: Have a strong ability to recognize characters independently. Cumulatively recognize about 3,000 commonly used characters, of which about 2,500 can be written. Appreciate the features of how Chinese characters are formed and combined into words, and appreciate the wisdom contained in them.

subject: ela
text_zh: 写字姿势正确，有良好的书写习惯。硬笔书写楷书，行款整齐，力求美观，有一定的速度。能用毛笔书写楷书，在书写中体会汉字的优美。
text_en: Have correct writing posture and good writing habits. Write regular script with a hard-tipped pen, with neat layout, striving for an attractive appearance and with a certain speed. Be able to write regular script with a brush, and appreciate the beauty of Chinese characters in writing.

subject: ela
text_zh: 熟练地用普通话正确、流利、有感情地朗读课文。默读有一定的速度，默读一般读物每分钟不少于300字。学习浏览，扩大知识面，根据需要搜集信息。
text_en: Read texts aloud skillfully in Putonghua, correctly, fluently, and with feeling. Read silently at a certain speed: no fewer than 300 characters per minute for ordinary reading material. Learn to browse, to broaden one's knowledge, and to collect information as needed.

subject: ela
text_zh: 能联系上下文和自己的积累，推想课文中有关词句的意思，辨别词语的感情色彩，体会其表达效果。在理解课文的过程中体会顿号与逗号、分号与句号的不同用法。
text_en: Be able to infer the meaning of relevant words and sentences in a text from context and one's own accumulated knowledge, distinguish the emotional coloring of words, and appreciate their expressive effect. In the process of understanding texts, appreciate the different uses of the enumeration comma versus the comma, and the semicolon versus the period.

subject: ela
text_zh: 在阅读中了解文章的表达顺序，体会作者的思想感情，初步领悟文章的基本表达方法。在交流和讨论中，敢于提出看法，作出自己的判断。
text_en: In reading, understand the order in which an article is presented, appreciate the author's thoughts and feelings, and begin to grasp the basic methods of expression in the article. In exchange and discussion, dare to put forward one's views and make one's own judgments.

subject: ela
text_zh: 阅读叙事性作品，了解事件梗概，能简单描述印象最深的场景、人物、细节，说出自己的喜爱、憎恶、崇敬、向往、同情等感受；阅读诗歌，大体把握诗意，想象诗歌描述的情境，体会作品的情感。受到优秀作品的感染和激励，向往和追求美好的理想。
text_en: Read narrative works and understand the outline of events; be able to describe briefly the scenes, characters, and details that left the deepest impression, and state one's feelings such as liking, dislike, admiration, longing, and sympathy. Read poetry, grasp its general meaning, imagine the situations it describes, and appreciate the emotions of the work. Be moved and inspired by excellent works, and aspire to and pursue beautiful ideals.

subject: ela
text_zh: 阅读说明性文章，能抓住要点，了解文章的基本说明方法。阅读简单的非连续性文本，能从图文等组合材料中找出有价值的信息。尝试使用多种媒介阅读。
text_en: Read expository articles, be able to pick out the key points, and understand the basic methods of exposition used. Read simple non-continuous texts, and be able to find valuable information from combined materials such as text and pictures. Try reading through a variety of media.

subject: ela
text_zh: 阅读整本书，把握文本的主要内容，积极向同学推荐并说明理由。
text_en: Read whole books, grasp the main content of the text, and actively recommend books to classmates with reasons.

subject: ela
text_zh: 背诵优秀诗文60篇（段），注意通过语调、韵律、节奏等体味作品的内容和情感。扩展阅读面，课外阅读总量不少于100万字。
