text_en: Recite 60 excellent poems and prose passages (or excerpts), taking care to appreciate the content and emotion of the work through intonation, rhyme, and rhythm. Broaden the range of reading; total extracurricular reading of no fewer than 1,000,000 characters.

subject: ela
text_zh: 听人说话认真、耐心，能抓住要点，并能简要转述。乐于表达，与人交流能尊重和理解对方。注意语言美，抵制不文明的语言。
text_en: Listen to others attentively and patiently, be able to grasp the key points and give a brief restatement. Be glad to express oneself, and respect and understand the other party when communicating. Attend to the beauty of language and reject uncivil language.

subject: ela
text_zh: 表达有条理，语气、语调适当。参与讨论，敢于发表自己的意见，说清自己的观点。能根据对象和场合，稍作准备，作简单的三、课程目标1发言。
text_en: Express oneself in an organized way, with appropriate tone and intonation. Take part in discussions, dare to express one's own opinions, and state one's views clearly. Be able to give a simple speech with a little preparation, according to the audience and occasion.

subject: ela
text_zh: 懂得写作是为了自我表达和与人交流。养成留心观察周围事物的习惯，有意识地丰富自己的见闻，珍视个人的独特感受，积累习作素材。
text_en: Understand that writing is for self-expression and for communicating with others. Form the habit of paying attention to the things around one, deliberately enrich one's experiences, value one's own unique feelings, and accumulate material for writing.

subject: ela
text_zh: 能写简单的记实作文和想象作文，内容具体，感情真实。能根据内容表达的需要，分段表述。学写读书笔记，学写常见应用文。
text_en: Be able to write simple factual compositions and imaginative compositions with concrete content and genuine feeling. Be able to divide a piece into paragraphs as the content requires. Learn to write reading notes and common practical writing.

subject: ela
text_zh: 修改自己的习作，并主动与他人交换修改，做到语句通顺，行款正确，书写规范、整洁。根据表达需要，正确使用常用的标点符号。习作要有一定速度。课内习作每学年16次左右。
text_en: Revise one's own writing and take the initiative to exchange pieces with others for revision, so that sentences read smoothly, layout is correct, and handwriting is standard and neat. Correctly use common punctuation marks as expression requires. Writing should be done at a certain speed. In-class composition about 16 times per school year.

subject: ela
text_zh: 分类整理学过的字词，发现所学汉字形、音、义和书写的特点，发展独立识字能力和写字能力。
text_en: Sort and organize the characters and words learned by category, discover the features of the form, sound, meaning, and writing of the characters learned, and develop the ability to recognize and write characters independently.

subject: ela
text_zh: 感受不同媒介的表达效果，学习跨媒介阅读与运用，初步运用多种方法整理和呈现信息。
text_en: Appreciate the expressive effects of different media, learn cross-media reading and use, and begin to use a variety of methods to organize and present information.

subject: ela
text_zh: 初步了解查找资料、运用资料的基本方法。利用图书馆、网络等渠道获取资料，解决与学习和生活相关的问题。尝试写简单的研究报告。
text_en: Begin to understand the basic methods of finding and using reference materials. Obtain materials through channels such as libraries and the internet to solve problems related to study and life. Try writing simple research reports.

subject: ela
text_zh: 策划简单的校园活动和社会活动，对所策划的主题进行讨论和分析，学写活动计划和活动总结。对自己身边的、大家共同关注的问题，或影视作品中的故事和形象，通过调查访问、讨论演讲等方式，开展专题探究活动，学习辨别是非、善恶、美丑。在落实以上要求过程中，注重了解中华优秀传统文化的源远流长、丰富多彩，提升自身中华优秀传统文化修养；感受先贤志士的人格魅力，感悟老一辈无产阶级革命家的英雄气概、优良作风和高尚品质，体会捍卫民族尊严、维护国家利益和世界和平的伟大精神。
text_en: Plan simple school and community activities, discuss and analyze the themes planned, and learn to write activity plans and activity summaries. For issues around oneself that concern everyone, or for stories and characters in films and television works, carry out thematic inquiry activities through surveys and interviews, discussion, and speeches, and learn to distinguish right from wrong, good from evil, and beauty from ugliness. In carrying out the above requirements, give emphasis to understanding the long history and rich variety of excellent traditional Chinese culture and raising one's own cultivation in it; to appreciating the personal charm of ancient sages and men of high ideals, and the heroic spirit, fine style, and noble qualities of the older generation of proletarian revolutionaries; and to appreciating the great spirit of defending national dignity, safeguarding national interests, and upholding world peace.

subject: ela
text_zh: 能熟练地使用字典、词典独立识字，会用多种检字方法。累计认识常用汉字3500个左右。
text_en: Be able to use dictionaries and word dictionaries skillfully to recognize characters independently, and know a variety of character look-up methods. Cumulatively recognize about 3,500 commonly used characters.

subject: ela
text_zh: 写字姿势正确，保持良好的书写习惯。在使用硬笔熟练地书写正楷字的基础上，学写规范、通行的行楷字，提高书写的速度。临摹、欣赏名家书法，体会书法的审美价值。
text_en: Have correct writing posture and maintain good writing habits. On the basis of writing regular script skillfully with a hard-tipped pen, learn to write standard, commonly used semi-cursive regular script (xingkai) and increase writing speed. Copy and appreciate the calligraphy of famous masters, and appreciate the aesthetic value of calligraphy.

subject: ela
text_zh: 能用普通话正确、流利、有感情地朗读。养成默读习惯，有一定的速度，阅读一般的现代文，每分钟不少于500字。能较熟练地运用略读和浏览的方法，扩大阅读范围。
text_en: Be able to read aloud in Putonghua correctly, fluently, and with feeling. Form the habit of silent reading at a certain speed: no fewer than 500 characters per minute for ordinary modern prose. Be able to use skimming and browsing fairly skillfully to widen the range of reading.

subject: ela
text_zh: 在通读课文的基础上，理清思路，理解、分析主要内容，体味和推敲重要词句在语言环境中的意义和作用。对课文的内容和表达有自己的心得，能提出自己的看法，并能与他人合作，共同探讨、分析、解决疑难问题。
text_en: On the basis of reading a text through, clarify its train of thought, understand and analyze its main content, and appreciate and weigh the meaning and function of important words and sentences in their language context. Have one's own insights into the content and expression of a text, be able to put forward one's own views, and be able to cooperate with others to explore, analyze, and resolve difficult questions together.

subject: ela
text_zh: 在阅读中了解叙述、描写、说明、议论、抒情等表达方式。能区分写实作品与虚构作品，了解诗歌、散文、小说、戏剧等文学样式。
text_en: In reading, understand modes of expression such as narration, description, exposition, argumentation, and lyricism. Be able to distinguish factual works from fictional works, and understand literary forms such as poetry, prose, fiction, and drama.

subject: ela
text_zh: 欣赏文学作品，有自己的情感体验，初步领悟作品的内涵，从中获得对自然、社会、人生的有益启示。能对作品中感人的情境和形象说出自己的体验，品味作品中富于表现力的语言。
text_en: Appreciate literary works, have one's own emotional experiences, begin to grasp the connotations of works, and gain from them useful insights about nature, society, and life. Be able to express one's own experience of moving scenes and images in a work, and savor the expressive language in works.

subject: ela
text_zh: 阅读简单的议论文，能区分观点与材料（道理、事实、数据、图表等），发现观点与材料之间的联系，并通过自己的思考，作出判断。阅读新闻和说明性文章，能把握文章的基本观点，获取主要信息。阅读科技作品，还应注意领会作品中所体现的科学精神和科学思三、课程日标10想方法。阅读由多种材料组合、较为复杂的非连续性文本，能领会文本的意思，得出有意义的结论。
text_en: Read simple argumentative essays, be able to distinguish viewpoints from supporting material (reasoning, facts, data, charts, etc.), discover the links between viewpoints and material, and make judgments through one's own thinking. Read news and expository articles, be able to grasp the basic viewpoint of an article and obtain the main information. When reading science and technology works, also take care to grasp the scientific spirit and scientific ways of thinking embodied in them. Read fairly complex non-continuous texts composed of multiple kinds of material, be able to grasp the meaning of the text and draw meaningful conclusions.

subject: ela
text_zh: 诵读古代诗词，阅读浅易文言文，能借助注释和工具书理解基本内容。注重积累、感悟和运用，提高自己的欣赏品位。背诵优秀诗文80篇（段）。
text_en: Recite classical poems and ci, and read simple classical Chinese prose, being able to understand the basic content with the help of annotations and reference books. Emphasize accumulation, insight, and application, and raise one's own appreciative taste. Recite 80 excellent poems and prose passages (or excerpts).

subject: ela
text_zh: 每学年阅读两三部名著，探索个性化的阅读方法，分享阅读感受，开展专题探究，建构阅读整本书的经验。感受经典名著的艺术魅力，丰富自己的精神世界。
text_en: Read two or three famous works each school year, explore personalized reading methods, share reading impressions, carry out thematic inquiry, and build experience in reading whole books. Feel the artistic charm of classic works and enrich one's inner world.

subject: ela
text_zh: 随文学习基本的词汇、语法知识，用以帮助理解课文中的语言难点；了解常用的修辞手法，体会它们在课文中的表达效果。了解课文涉及的重要作家作品知识和文化常识。
text_en: Learn basic knowledge of vocabulary and grammar along with the texts, and use it to help understand language difficulties in them; understand common rhetorical devices and appreciate their expressive effect in the texts. Understand knowledge about the important writers and works referred to in the texts, and general cultural knowledge.

subject: ela
text_zh: 能利用图书馆、网络搜集自己需要的信息和资料，帮助阅读。学会制订自己的阅读计划，广泛阅读各种类型的读物，课外阅读总量不少于260万字。
text_en: Be able to use libraries and the internet to collect the information and materials one needs to support reading. Learn to draw up one's own reading plan and read widely among various types of reading material; total extracurricular reading of no fewer than 2,600,000 characters.

subject: ela
text_zh: 注意对象和场合，学习文明得体地交流。耐心专注地倾听，能根据对方的话语、表情、手势等，理解对方的观点和意图。
text_en: Pay attention to the audience and occasion, and learn to communicate in a civil and appropriate way. Listen patiently and attentively, and be able to understand the other party's views and intentions from their words, expressions, gestures, and so on.

subject: ela
text_zh: 自信、负责地表达自己的观点，做到清楚、连贯、不偏离话题。注意表情和语气，根据需要调整自己的表达内容和方式，不断提高应对能力，增强感染力和说服力。
text_en: Express one's views with confidence and responsibility, clearly, coherently, and without straying from the topic. Pay attention to facial expression and tone, adjust the content and manner of one's expression as needed, continually improve the ability to respond, and strengthen appeal and persuasiveness.

subject: ela
text_zh: 讲述见闻，内容具体、语言生动。复述转述，完整准确、突出要点。能就适当的话题作即席讲话和有准备的主题演讲，有自己的观点，有一定说服力。讨论问题，能积极发表自己的看法，有中心，有根据，有条理；能把握讨论的焦点，并能有针对性地发表意见。
text_en: When recounting what one has seen and heard, make the content concrete and the language vivid. When retelling or restating, be complete and accurate and highlight the key points. Be able to give impromptu remarks on suitable topics and prepared thematic speeches, with one's own viewpoint and a degree of persuasiveness. When discussing problems, be able to actively express one's own views, with a central point, grounds, and organization; be able to grasp the focus of the discussion and give targeted opinions.

subject: ela
text_zh: 多角度观察生活，发现生活的丰富多彩，能抓住事物的特征，为写作奠定基础。写作要有真情实感，表达自己对自然、社会、人生的感受、体验和思考，力求有创意。
text_en: Observe life from many angles, discover its richness and variety, and be able to capture the distinguishing features of things, laying a foundation for writing. Writing should have genuine feeling and express one's feelings, experiences, and thoughts about nature, society, and life, striving to be creative.

subject: ela
text_zh: 写作时考虑不同的目的和对象。根据表达的需要，围绕表达中心，选择恰当的表达方式。合理安排内容的先后和详略，条理清楚地表达自己的意思。运用联想和想象，丰富表达的内容。正确使用常用的标点符号。
text_en: When writing, consider different purposes and audiences. According to the needs of expression, choose appropriate modes of expression around the central idea. Arrange the order and the degree of detail of content reasonably, and express one's meaning in an orderly and clear way. Use association and imagination to enrich the content expressed. Correctly use common punctuation marks.

subject: ela
text_zh: 写记叙性文章，表达意图明确，内容具体充实；写简单的说明性文章，做到明白清楚；写简单的议论性文章，做到观点明确，有理有据；能根据生活需要，写常见应用文。能从文章中提取主要信息，进行缩写；能根据文章的基本内容和自己的合理想象，进行扩写；能变换文章的文体或表达方式等，进行改写。尝试诗歌、小小说的写作。
text_en: Write narrative pieces with a clear intention and concrete, substantial content; write simple expository pieces that are plain and clear; write simple argumentative pieces with a clear viewpoint and sound reasons and grounds; be able to write common practical writing according to the needs of life. Be able to extract the main information from an article and write an abridgment; be able to write an expansion based on the basic content of an article and one's own reasonable imagination; be able to change the genre or mode of expression of an article and write an adaptation. Try writing poetry and short short stories.

subject: ela
text_zh: 注重写作过程中搜集素材、构思立意、列纲起草、修改加工等环节，提高独立写作的能力。根据表达的需要，借助语感和语文常识修改自己的作文，做到文从字顺。能与他人交流写作心得，互相评改作文，以分享感受，沟通见解。作文每学年一般不少于14次，其他练笔不少于1万字，45分钟能完成不少于500字的习作。
text_en: Pay attention to the stages of the writing process, such as collecting material, conceiving the theme, drafting an outline and a first draft, and revising and polishing, and improve the ability to write independently. According to the needs of expression, revise one's own compositions with the help of a feel for language and basic knowledge of Chinese, so that the writing is fluent and well formed. Be able to exchange writing experiences with others and assess and revise each other's compositions, in order to share feelings and exchange views. Compositions generally no fewer than 14 per school year, other writing practice no fewer than 10,000 characters, and be able to complete a piece of no fewer than 500 characters in 45 minutes.

subject: ela
text_zh: 按照一定的标准分类整理学过的字词句篇等语言材料，梳理、反思自己语文学习的经验，努力提高语言文字运用能力，增强表达效果。
text_en: Sort and organize language material such as the characters, words, sentences, and texts learned according to certain criteria, sort out and reflect on one's own experience of learning Chinese, and work to improve the ability to use language and script and to strengthen expressive effect.

subject: ela
text_zh: 学习跨媒介阅读与运用，体会不同媒介的表达特点，根据需要选用合适的媒介呈现探究结果。
text_en: Learn cross-media reading and use, appreciate the expressive characteristics of different media, and choose suitable media as needed to present the results of inquiry.

subject: ela
text_zh: 自主组织文学活动，在办刊、演出、讨论等活动过程中体验合作与成功的喜悦。关心学校、本地区和国内外大事，就共同关注的热点问题搜集资料，调查访问，相互讨论，能用文字、图表、图画、照片等展示学习成果。
text_en: Organize literary activities independently, and experience the joy of cooperation and success in the course of activities such as running a publication, performing, and holding discussions. Care about major events in the school, the local area, and at home and abroad; collect materials on hot issues of common concern, conduct surveys and interviews, discuss with one another, and be able to present learning outcomes in text, charts, drawings, photographs, and so on.

subject: ela
text_zh: 能提出学习和生活中感兴趣的问题，共同讨论，选出研究主题，制订简单的研究计划。能从书刊或其他媒体中获取有关资料，讨三、课程日标10论分析问题，独立或合作写出简单的研究报告。掌握查找资料、引用资料的基本方法，分清原始资料与间接资料，学会注明所援引资料的出处。在落实以上要求过程中，注重理解中华优秀传统文化蕴含的核心思想理念、中华人文精神和传统美德，表达自己作为中华民族一员的归属感和自豪感；体会中国共产党在长期奋斗历程中培育形成的崇高精神和人格风范，体认英雄模范忠于祖国和人民的优秀品质，培育民族气节和爱国主义情怀。（一）主题与载体形式
text_en: Be able to raise questions of interest from study and life, discuss them together, select a research theme, and draw up a simple research plan. Be able to obtain relevant materials from books, periodicals, or other media, discuss and analyze problems, and write a simple research report independently or in cooperation. Master the basic methods of finding and citing materials, distinguish primary sources from secondary sources, and learn to cite the sources of the materials quoted. In carrying out the above requirements, give emphasis to understanding the core ideas and concepts, the Chinese humanistic spirit, and the traditional virtues contained in excellent traditional Chinese culture, and to expressing one's sense of belonging and pride as a member of the Chinese nation; to appreciating the lofty spirit and personal bearing fostered by the Communist Party of China over its long course of struggle, and recognizing the fine quality of heroes and models in their loyalty to the motherland and the people, fostering national integrity and patriotic feeling. (I) Themes and Forms of Carriers

subject: ela
text_zh: 中华优秀传统文化围绕创造性转化和创新性发展要求，确定中华优秀传统文化内容主题，注重弘扬讲仁爱、重民本、守诚信、崇正义、尚和合、求大同等核心思想理念；弘扬有利于促进社会和谐、鼓励人们向上向善的中华人文精神；弘扬自强不息、敬业乐群、扶危济困、见义勇为、孝老爱亲等中华传统美德。主要载体汉字、书法，成语、格言警句，神话传说、寓言故事、历史故事、民间故事、中华民族团结一家亲的故事，古代诗词、古代散文、古典小说，古代文化常识、传统节日、风俗习惯等。
text_en: Excellent traditional Chinese culture: Centering on the requirements of creative transformation and innovative development, determine the content themes of excellent traditional Chinese culture, with emphasis on promoting core ideas and concepts such as benevolence, regarding the people as the foundation, keeping faith, upholding justice, valuing harmony and unity, and seeking a world of great harmony; promoting the Chinese humanistic spirit that fosters social harmony and encourages people to strive upward and toward good; and promoting traditional Chinese virtues such as self-improvement without ceasing, dedication to one's work and friendliness to others, helping those in danger and need, acting bravely for a just cause, and filial piety and love for family. Main carriers: Chinese characters and calligraphy; idioms, maxims, and aphorisms; myths and legends, fables, historical stories, folk tales, and stories of the Chinese nation as one close family; ancient poems and ci, ancient prose, and classical novels; general knowledge of ancient culture, traditional festivals, customs, and so on.

subject: ela
text_zh: 革命文化围绕伟大建党精神，确定革命文化内容主题，注重反映理想信念、爱国情怀、艰苦奋斗、无私奉献、顽强斗争和英勇无畏等革命传统。主要载体为老一辈无产阶级革命家和革命英雄人物的代表性作品及反映他们生平事迹的传记、故事等作品，反映党领导人民革命的伟大历程和重要事件的作品，有关革命传统人物、事件、节日、纪念日活动等方面的作品，阐发革命精神的作品，革命圣地、革命旧址和革命文物等。
text_en: Revolutionary culture: Centering on the great spirit of the founding of the Party, determine the content themes of revolutionary culture, with emphasis on reflecting revolutionary traditions such as ideals and convictions, patriotic feeling, hard struggle, selfless dedication, tenacious struggle, and heroic fearlessness. Main carriers: representative works of the older generation of proletarian revolutionaries and revolutionary heroes, and biographies, stories, and other works reflecting their lives and deeds; works reflecting the great course and important events of the people's revolution led by the Party; works about revolutionary-tradition figures, events, festivals, and commemorative activities; works that expound the revolutionary spirit; revolutionary holy sites, former revolutionary sites, and revolutionary cultural relics, and so on.

subject: ela
text_zh: 社会主义先进文化围绕社会主义核心价值观，确定社会主义先进文化内容主题，突出爱党、爱国、爱社会主义相统一。主要载体为反映社会主义建设事业中取得的重大成就、涌现出来的模范人物与先进事迹的作品；反映当代中国从站起来、富起来到强起来的奋斗历程和重大事件，以及体现中国式现代化新道路和人类文明新形态的相关作品；反映和谐互助、共同富裕、改革创新、劳动创造美好生活等方面的作品。在突出上述主题的同时，还应选择反映世界文明优秀成果、科技进步、日常生活特别是儿童生活等方面的主题。主要载体外国文学名著、科普科幻作品、实用性文章、中外优秀儿童文学作品等。各类主题的主要载体还应包括口头和书面交流与沟通、跨媒介阅读与表达等语文实践活动。根据不同学段特点，统筹安排各类主题的相关学习内容。体现中华优秀传统文化、革命文化、社会主义先进文化的作品，应占60%~70%；反映科技、自然、生活等方面的应用、说明、记叙类作品，以及外国优秀文化作品，占30%~40%。（二）内容组织与呈现方式义务教育语文课程内容主要以学习任务群组织与呈现。设计语文学习任务，要围绕特定学习主题，确定具有内在逻辑关联的语文实践活动。语文学习任务群由相互关联的系列学习任务组成，共同指向学生的核心素养发展，具有情境性、实践性、综合性。义务教育语文课程按照内容整合程度不断提升，分三个层面设置学习任务群，其中第一层设“语言文字积累与梳理”1个基础型学习任务群，第二层设“实用性阅读与交流”“文学阅读与创意表达”“思辨性阅读与表达”3个发展型学习任务群，第三层设“整本书阅读”“跨学科学习”2个拓展型学习任务群。根据学段特点，学习任务群安排可有所侧重。
text_en: Advanced socialist culture: Centering on the core socialist values, determine the content themes of advanced socialist culture, highlighting the unity of loving the Party, loving the country, and loving socialism. Main carriers: works reflecting major achievements in socialist construction and the model figures and exemplary deeds that have emerged; works reflecting the struggle and major events of contemporary China from standing up to growing prosperous to growing strong, and works embodying the new path of Chinese modernization and the new form of human civilization; works reflecting harmony and mutual help, common prosperity, reform and innovation, and labor creating a better life. While highlighting the above themes, also select themes reflecting the outstanding achievements of world civilization, scientific and technological progress, and daily life, especially children's lives. Main carriers: famous works of foreign literature, popular science and science fiction works, practical writing, and excellent Chinese and foreign children's literature, and so on. The main carriers for each type of theme should also include Chinese language practice activities such as oral and written communication and cross-media reading and expression. According to the characteristics of each stage, make overall arrangements for the learning content related to each type of theme. Works embodying excellent traditional Chinese culture, revolutionary culture, and advanced socialist culture should account for 60%-70%; practical, expository, and narrative works reflecting science and technology, nature, and life, as well as excellent foreign cultural works, should account for 30%-40%. (II) Organization and Presentation of Content: The content of the compulsory-education Chinese language curriculum is mainly organized and presented through learning task groups. In designing Chinese language learning tasks, Chinese language practice activities with an internal logical connection should be determined around a specific learning theme. A Chinese language learning task group consists of a series of interrelated learning tasks that jointly point toward the development of students' core competencies, and it is situational, practical, and integrated. As the degree of content integration rises, the compulsory-education Chinese language curriculum sets up learning task groups at three levels: the first level has 1 foundational learning task group, "Accumulation and Sorting of Language and Script"; the second level has 3 developmental learning task groups, "Practical Reading and Communication," "Literary Reading and Creative Expression," and "Reflective Reading and Expression"; the third level has 2 expanded learning task groups, "Whole-Book Reading" and "Cross-Disciplinary Learning." Depending on the characteristics of each stage, the arrangement of learning task groups may have different emphases.

subject: ela
text_zh: 基础型学习任务群语言文字积累与梳理本学习任务群旨在引导学生在语文实践活动中，积累语言材料和语言经验，形成良好语感；通过观察、分析、整理，发现汉字的构字组词特点，掌握语言文字运用规范，感受汉字的文化内涵，奠定语文基础。
text_en: Foundational learning task group: Accumulation and Sorting of Language and Script. This learning task group aims to guide students, in Chinese language practice activities, to accumulate language material and language experience and form a good feel for language; through observation, analysis, and sorting, to discover the features of how Chinese characters are formed and combined into words, master the norms for using language and script, appreciate the cultural connotations of Chinese characters, and lay a foundation for Chinese language learning.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 史前时期：通过了解元谋人、蓝田人、北京人等旧石器时代的人类及其文化遗存，知道中国境内原始社会时期的人类活动；通过了解河姆渡、半坡、良渚、陶寺等新石器时代的文化遗存，知道中国的原始农耕生活；了解私有制、阶级和早期国家的产生；知道考古发现是了解原始社会的重要依据；通过古代文献中记述的黄帝、炎帝等神话传说，了解其中蕴含的历史信息。
text_en: Prehistoric period: Through learning about Paleolithic humans such as Yuanmou Man, Lantian Man, and Peking Man and their cultural remains, know about human activity in primitive society within China's territory; through learning about Neolithic cultural remains such as Hemudu, Banpo, Liangzhu, and Taosi, know about primitive farming life in China; understand the emergence of private ownership, classes, and early states; know that archaeological discoveries are an important basis for understanding primitive society; through the myths and legends of figures such as the Yellow Emperor and the Yan Emperor recorded in ancient texts, understand the historical information they contain.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 夏商西周与春秋战国时期：知道甲骨文是已知最早的汉字；通过了解甲骨文、青铜铭文、其他文献记载和典型器物，知道具有奴隶制特点的夏、商、西周王朝的建立与发展，了解西周分封制等重要制度；知道老子、孔子的生平与思想；通过了解这一时期的生产力水平和社会关系的变化，初步理解春秋时期请侯争霸局面的形成、战国时期商鞅变法等改革和“百家争鸣”局面的产生；通过《黄帝内经》和名医扁鹊，了解这一时期的医学成就；通过都江堰工程，感受古代劳动人民的智慧和创造力。
text_en: Xia, Shang, and Western Zhou, and the Spring and Autumn and Warring States periods: Know that oracle bone script is the earliest known Chinese writing; through learning about oracle bone inscriptions, bronze inscriptions, other documentary records, and typical artifacts, know about the establishment and development of the Xia, Shang, and Western Zhou dynasties, which had the characteristics of slave-owning societies, and understand important institutions such as the Western Zhou enfeoffment system; know the lives and thought of Laozi and Confucius; through learning about changes in productive forces and social relations in this period, begin to understand the formation of the hegemony contest among the feudal lords in the Spring and Autumn period, reforms such as Shang Yang's reforms in the Warring States period, and the emergence of the "Contention of the Hundred Schools of Thought"; through the Huangdi Neijing (Yellow Emperor's Inner Canon) and the famous physician Bian Que, understand the medical achievements of this period; through the Dujiangyan project, appreciate the wisdom and creativity of the ancient laboring people.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 秦汉时期：通过了解秦朝统一、陈胜和吴广等领导的秦末农民起义、西汉“削藩”和尊崇儒术，知道统一多民族封建国家建立和早期发展的过程；通过了解休养生息政策、“文景之治”、张骞通西域、“丝绸之路”的开辟、汉武帝的大一统，知道西汉从建立之初的社会残破发展到国力强盛的变化及原因；通过了解西汉末到东汉的政治、社会动荡，了解佛教传入和道教产生的背景；知道这一时期的重要文化和科技成就，如司马迁与《史记》、蔡伦与造纸术、张仲景与《伤寒杂病论》、华佗的故事等。
text_en: Qin and Han periods: Through learning about the unification by the Qin dynasty, the peasant uprising at the end of Qin led by Chen Sheng and Wu Guang, the Western Han "reduction of the vassal states," and the honoring of Confucianism, know the process of the establishment and early development of the unified, multi-ethnic feudal state; through learning about the policy of rest and recuperation, the "Rule of Wen and Jing," Zhang Qian's mission to the Western Regions, the opening of the "Silk Road," and Emperor Wu of Han's great unification, know how the Western Han developed from a war-ravaged society at its founding to great national strength, and the reasons for this change; through learning about the political and social turmoil from late Western Han to Eastern Han, understand the background of the introduction of Buddhism and the emergence of Daoism; know the important cultural, scientific, and technological achievements of this period, such as Sima Qian and the Records of the Grand Historian, Cai Lun and papermaking, Zhang Zhongjing and the Treatise on Cold Damage and Miscellaneous Diseases, and the stories of Hua Tuo.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 三国两晋南北朝时期：通过了解三国两晋南北朝时期的政权更迭和北魏孝文帝改革、人口迁徙和区域开发，认识这一时期民族交往交流交融的历史特点及其对中华民族发展的意义；通过了解这一时期的科技和艺术成就，如祖冲之的数学成就，认识传统文化的继承与创新。
text_en: Three Kingdoms, Western and Eastern Jin, and Southern and Northern Dynasties: Through learning about the changes of regimes in the Three Kingdoms, Jin, and Southern and Northern Dynasties periods, the reforms of Emperor Xiaowen of the Northern Wei, population migration, and regional development, understand the historical features of ethnic contact, exchange, and integration in this period and their significance for the development of the Chinese nation; through learning about the scientific, technological, and artistic achievements of this period, such as Zu Chongzhi's mathematical achievements, understand the inheritance and innovation of traditional culture.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 隋唐五代十国时期：通过了解隋朝的兴亡、“贞观之治”与“开元盛世”，知道隋朝速亡和唐朝兴盛的原因；了解科举制度创建、大运河开通、文成公主入藏、鉴真东渡、玄奘西行等史事，从制度、经济、文学艺术、民族交往、中外文化交流等方面认识隋唐王朝在世界历史上的重要地位；通过了解“安史之乱”后藩镇割据和五代十国的局面，认识唐末五代的社会危机。
text_en: Sui, Tang, and Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms: Through learning about the rise and fall of the Sui dynasty, the "Rule of Zhenguan," and the "Flourishing Age of Kaiyuan," know the reasons for the Sui's swift collapse and the Tang's prosperity; learn about historical events such as the creation of the imperial examination system, the opening of the Grand Canal, Princess Wencheng's journey to Tibet, Jianzhen's voyage east to Japan, and Xuanzang's pilgrimage west, and understand the important place of the Sui and Tang dynasties in world history in terms of institutions, economy, literature and art, ethnic contact, and Chinese-foreign cultural exchange; through learning about the division by military governors after the "An Lushan and Shi Siming Rebellion" and the situation of the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms, understand the social crisis of the late Tang and Five Dynasties.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 辽宋夏金元时期：认识北宋面临的新形势，了解辽、宋、西夏的并立与北宋强化中央集权和重文轻武的政策；通过了解宋金之战、南宋偏安和南方地区的经济繁菜，知道中国古代经济重心的进一步南移；通过了解蒙古兴起和元朝统一，设立行省、宣政院等制度，知道西藏在元代正式纳入中国版图，理解元朝统一对中华民族进一步交融的重要意义；通过了解这一时期的城市和商业发展、科技创新、文学艺术成就和对外交流，认识宋元时期繁荣的经济、文化在中国历史上的重要地位；通过岳飞、文天祥等人的英雄事迹，体会中华民族英勇不屈的精神；通过印刷术、指南针、火药的应用和外传，认识中国古代的重要发明对世界文明发展的贡献。
text_en: Liao, Song, Xia, Jin, and Yuan periods: Understand the new situation facing the Northern Song, and learn about the coexistence of the Liao, Song, and Western Xia and the Northern Song's policies of strengthening centralized power and favoring the civil over the military; through learning about the wars between the Song and Jin, the Southern Song's retreat to a corner of the south, and the economic prosperity of the southern regions, know the further southward shift of the center of gravity of the economy in ancient China; through learning about the rise of the Mongols and the unification under the Yuan dynasty and the establishment of institutions such as the provincial administrations and the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs, know that Tibet was formally incorporated into China's territory in the Yuan dynasty, and understand the important significance of the Yuan unification for the further integration of the Chinese nation; through learning about urban and commercial development, scientific and technological innovation, literary and artistic achievements, and foreign exchange in this period, understand the important place in Chinese history of the flourishing economy and culture of the Song and Yuan periods; through the heroic deeds of figures such as Yue Fei and Wen Tianxiang, appreciate the heroic and unyielding spirit of the Chinese nation; through the application and spread abroad of printing, the compass, and gunpowder, understand the contribution of important ancient Chinese inventions to the development of world civilization.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 明清时期（至鸦片战争前）：通过了解明清时期加强皇权的举措，初步认识君主专制带来的社会弊端；通过了解明清时期的经济改革和全球性经济互动，初步认识这一阶段中国经济发展的内因和外因；通过郑和下西洋、戚继光抗倭等史事，了解明朝的对外关系；通过了解郑成功收复台湾、清朝在台湾的建制、册封达赖和班禅以及设置驻藏大臣等中央政权在边疆地区的各种举措，认识西藏地区、新疆地区、南海诸岛、台湾及其包括钓鱼岛在内的附属岛屿是中国的领士，理解统一多民族国家版图奠定的重要意义；通过了解《本草纲目》《天工开物》《农政全书》，认识明朝的科技成就及其影响；通过了解小说、戏曲的繁菜，知道明清时期文学艺术的特色；通过明末李自成起义，清中叶以来的政治腐败、故步自封和19世纪的国际局势，认识当时中国社会面临的严重危机。
text_en: Ming and Qing periods (up to before the Opium War): Through learning about the measures to strengthen imperial power in the Ming and Qing periods, begin to understand the social ills brought by monarchical autocracy; through learning about the economic reforms and global economic interaction of the Ming and Qing periods, begin to understand the internal and external causes of China's economic development in this stage; through historical events such as Zheng He's voyages to the Western Seas and Qi Jiguang's resistance to Japanese pirates, understand the Ming dynasty's foreign relations; through learning about Zheng Chenggong's recovery of Taiwan, the Qing dynasty's administrative establishment in Taiwan, the conferment of titles on the Dalai Lama and Panchen Lama, and the establishment of the Imperial Resident Minister in Tibet, along with other measures of the central government in border regions, recognize that the Tibet region, the Xinjiang region, the South China Sea islands, and Taiwan together with its affiliated islands including the Diaoyu Islands are Chinese territory, and understand the important significance of the territorial foundation of the unified multi-ethnic state; through learning about the Compendium of Materia Medica, Tiangong Kaiwu (The Exploitation of the Works of Nature), and the Complete Treatise on Agriculture (Nongzheng Quanshu), understand the scientific and technological achievements of the Ming dynasty and their influence; through learning about the flourishing of fiction and drama, know the characteristics of Ming and Qing literature and art; through Li Zicheng's uprising at the end of the Ming, the political corruption and self-satisfied isolation from the mid-Qing onward, and the international situation of the 19th century, recognize the serious crisis facing Chinese society at that time.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 晚清时期的内忧外患与救亡图存：通过了解林则徐虎门销烟、英法联军火烧圆明园、俄国割占中国北方大片领土等两次鸦片战争期间的主要史事，以及《南京条约》等不平等条约的签订，初步认识鸦片战争对中国近代社会的影响；了解太平天国运动的兴衰；了解洋务运动的主要内容，初步认识洋务运动的作用和局限性；了解19世纪中后期的边疆危机和中法战争，知道甲午中日战争的主要战役和《马关条约》的主要内容，初步认识《马关条约》与中国民族危机加剧的关系；了解戊戌变法的主要史事，认识变法的意义和局限性；知道义和团运动和抗击八国联军侵华的史事，结合《辛丑条约》的主要内容，认识《辛丑条约》对中国民族危机全面加深的影响。
text_en: Internal troubles and foreign aggression in the late Qing and the struggle for national survival: Through learning about the main events of the two Opium Wars, such as Lin Zexu's destruction of opium at Humen, the burning of the Old Summer Palace (Yuanmingyuan) by the Anglo-French allied forces, and Russia's seizure of large areas of China's northern territory, as well as the signing of unequal treaties such as the Treaty of Nanjing, begin to understand the impact of the Opium War on modern Chinese society; learn about the rise and fall of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom movement; learn about the main content of the Self-Strengthening Movement and begin to understand its role and limitations; learn about the border crises and the Sino-French War of the mid-to-late 19th century, know the main battles of the First Sino-Japanese War (Jiawu War) and the main content of the Treaty of Shimonoseki, and begin to understand the relationship between the Treaty of Shimonoseki and the intensification of China's national crisis; learn about the main events of the Hundred Days' Reform (Wuxu Reform) and understand its significance and limitations; know the Boxer Movement and the resistance to the invasion of the Eight-Power Allied Forces, and, in light of the main content of the Boxer Protocol (Xinchou Treaty), understand the effect of the Boxer Protocol in deepening China's national crisis across the board.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 辛亥革命与中华民国的建立：通过了解孙中山等民主革命先行者早年的革命活动、武昌起义及中华民国成立的史事，认识辛亥革命的历史意义及局限性；知道民国初期北洋军阀的统治；了解新文化运动的基本内容，知道陈独秀、李大钊、胡适、鲁迅等新文化运动的代表人物，认识新文化运动在中国近代思想解放运动中的地位和作用。
text_en: The Revolution of 1911 and the founding of the Republic of China: Through learning about the early revolutionary activities of pioneers of the democratic revolution such as Sun Yat-sen, the Wuchang Uprising, and the founding of the Republic of China, understand the historical significance and limitations of the Revolution of 1911; know the rule of the Beiyang warlords in the early Republic; learn about the basic content of the New Culture Movement, know its representative figures such as Chen Duxiu, Li Dazhao, Hu Shi, and Lu Xun, and understand the place and role of the New Culture Movement in the movement for intellectual emancipation in modern China.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 近代社会生活变化：通过了解张謇兴办实业的典型事例，知道近代中国民族工业发展的艰辛历程；通过了解开办京师大学堂、废除科举制度等近代新式教育发展的主要史事及民国以来社会生活的变化，知道中国走向现代化的曲折过程。
text_en: Changes in modern social life: Through learning about typical examples of Zhang Jian's founding of industrial enterprises, know the arduous course of the development of national industry in modern China; through learning about the main events in the development of modern new-style education, such as the founding of the Imperial University of Peking (Jingshi Daxuetang) and the abolition of the imperial examination system, and about changes in social life since the founding of the Republic, know the winding process of China's move toward modernization.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 中国共产党成立与新民主主义革命的兴起：通过了解五四运动的基本史事，理解五四精神的内涵，认识五四运动是中国新民主主义革命的开端；通过了解陈独秀、李大钊传播马克思主义和中国共产党第一次全国代表大会的召开等史事，认识中国共产党成立的历史意义，理解伟大建党精神；了解第一次国共合作和北伐战争等国民革命的主要内容；知道南京国民政府的成立及性质；通过了解南昌起义、八七会议、秋收起义、毛泽东与朱德井冈山会师、古田会议等基本史事，认识中国共产党创建人民军队和农村革命根据地的意义；认识遵义会议在中国革命史上的地位；通过了解长征途中红军爬雪山过草地等艰难历程的史事，感悟长征精神。
text_en: The founding of the Communist Party of China and the rise of the New Democratic Revolution: Through learning about the basic events of the May Fourth Movement, understand the meaning of the May Fourth spirit and recognize that the May Fourth Movement marked the beginning of China's New Democratic Revolution; through learning about events such as Chen Duxiu's and Li Dazhao's dissemination of Marxism and the convening of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China, recognize the historical significance of the Party's founding and understand the great spirit of the founding of the Party; learn about the main content of the national revolution, including the First Kuomintang-Communist Cooperation and the Northern Expedition; know the founding and nature of the Nanjing National Government; through learning about basic events such as the Nanchang Uprising, the August 7 Meeting, the Autumn Harvest Uprising, the meeting of Mao Zedong and Zhu De at Jinggangshan, and the Gutian Conference, recognize the significance of the Communist Party of China's creation of the people's army and rural revolutionary base areas; recognize the place of the Zunyi Meeting in the history of the Chinese revolution; through learning about the events of the Red Army's arduous journey on the Long March, crossing snow-covered mountains and grasslands, appreciate the spirit of the Long March.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 中华民族的抗日战争：通过了解九一八事变、东北抗联、一二•九运动、西安事变、七七事变、南京大屠杀、正面战场和敌后战场的抗战等史事，认识日本侵华的罪行，认识中国人民十四年抗战的艰苦历程，认识中国共产党是全民族抗战的中流砥柱，知道中国战场是世界反法西斯战争的东方主战场，体会中国军民在抗日战争中孕育的抗战精神，认识抗日战争胜利在中华民族伟大复兴中的重要历史意义；通过了解中共七大，认识确立毛泽东思想作为党的指导思想的重大意义。
text_en: The Chinese nation's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression: Through learning about events such as the September 18 Incident, the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army, the December 9th Movement, the Xi'an Incident, the July 7 Incident, the Nanjing Massacre, and the resistance on the frontal battlefield and the battlefield behind enemy lines, recognize the crimes of Japan's invasion of China, recognize the arduous course of the Chinese people's fourteen years of resistance, recognize that the Communist Party of China was the mainstay of the nationwide resistance, know that the Chinese theater was the main Eastern theater of the world anti-fascist war, appreciate the spirit of resistance fostered by Chinese soldiers and civilians in the War of Resistance, and recognize the important historical significance of victory in the War of Resistance for the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation; through learning about the Seventh National Congress of the Communist Party of China, recognize the great significance of establishing Mao Zedong Thought as the Party's guiding ideology.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 人民解放战争：知道重庆谈判，理解中国共产党为争取和平民主作出的努力；了解全面内战的爆发、中共中央转战陕北和刘邓大军挺进大别山等史事；通过了解解放区的土地改革，辽沈、淮海、平津三大战役，中共七届二中全会，知道国民党反动统治的覆灭和人民解放战争迅速胜利的主要原因，以及中国共产党领导人民取得新民主主义革命胜利的意义。
text_en: The People's War of Liberation: Know the Chongqing Negotiations and understand the efforts the Communist Party of China made to win peace and democracy; learn about events such as the outbreak of full-scale civil war, the CPC Central Committee's shifting of operations in northern Shaanxi, and the Liu-Deng army's advance into the Dabie Mountains; through learning about land reform in the liberated areas, the three great campaigns (Liaoshen, Huaihai, and Pingjin), and the Second Plenary Session of the Seventh Central Committee, know the main reasons for the collapse of the reactionary Kuomintang rule and the rapid victory of the People's War of Liberation, and the significance of the Communist Party of China's leading the people to victory in the New Democratic Revolution.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 中华人民共和国成立及向社会主义过渡：了解中国人民政治协商会议召开、开国大典，认识中华人民共和国成立对中国和世界历史的伟大意义；知道抗美援朝、土地改革，理解其对巩固人民民主政权的意义；通过《中华人民共和国宪法》的制定，以及人民代表大会制度、中国共产党领导的多党合作和政治协商制度、民族区域自治制度的确立，认识当代中国政治制度的内涵及意义；了解“一五”计划、“三大改造”、开创独立自主的和平外交，理解建立社会主义制度的重要意义。
text_en: The founding of the People's Republic of China and the transition to socialism: Learn about the convening of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference and the founding ceremony of the nation, and recognize the great significance of the founding of the People's Republic of China for Chinese and world history; know the War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea and land reform, and understand their significance for consolidating the people's democratic political power; through the drafting of the Constitution of the People's Republic of China and the establishment of the system of people's congresses, the system of multi-party cooperation and political consultation under the leadership of the Communist Party of China, and the system of regional ethnic autonomy, recognize the connotation and significance of contemporary China's political system; learn about the First Five-Year Plan, the "Three Great Transformations," and the launch of an independent and peaceful foreign policy, and understand the important significance of establishing the socialist system.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 社会主义革命和社会主义建设道路的探索：知道中共八大；了解“大跃进”运动、人民公社化运动等错误与调整国民经济的“八字方针”；认识这一时期取得的政治、经济、外交、国防、科技等成就及其具有的开创性、奠基性意义；了解毛泽东对中国社会主义革命和社会主义建设的贡献，认识毛泽东思想的重要指导意义；了解以王进喜、雷锋、钱学森、邓稼先、焦裕禄等为代表的广大干部群众艰苦奋斗的事迹；了解“文化大革命”的严重危害及主要教训。
text_en: Socialist revolution and exploration of the path of socialist construction: Know the Eighth National Congress of the Communist Party of China; learn about errors such as the "Great Leap Forward" and the people's commune movement, and about the "Eight-Character Policy" for adjusting the national economy; recognize the achievements in politics, economy, foreign affairs, national defense, science and technology, and other fields in this period and their pioneering and foundational significance; learn about Mao Zedong's contributions to China's socialist revolution and socialist construction and recognize the important guiding significance of Mao Zedong Thought; learn about the deeds of arduous struggle of the broad mass of cadres and people, represented by Wang Jinxi, Lei Feng, Qian Xuesen, Deng Jiaxian, Jiao Yulu, and others; learn about the serious harm of the "Cultural Revolution" and its main lessons.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 改革开放与中国特色社会主义建设：知道中共十一届三中全会，了解农村改革、城市改革、经济特区建设、沿海港口城市开放、上海浦东开发开放、加入世界贸易组织等史事，认识邓小平对改革开放所起的重要作用，认识改革开放对中国社会发展的重大意义和对世界的重要影响；了解社会主义市场经济体制的建立与完善；知道“一国两制”对实现祖国完全统一的意义；了解改革开放后的外交成就；了解邓小平理论、“三个代表”重要思想、科学发展观对社会主义现代化建设的重要指导意义。
text_en: Reform and opening up and the building of socialism with Chinese characteristics: Know the Third Plenary Session of the Eleventh Central Committee, and learn about events such as rural reform, urban reform, the building of special economic zones, the opening of coastal port cities, the development and opening of Shanghai's Pudong, and accession to the World Trade Organization; recognize the important role Deng Xiaoping played in reform and opening up, and the great significance of reform and opening up for China's social development and its important influence on the world; learn about the establishment and improvement of the socialist market economy system; know the significance of "one country, two systems" for achieving the complete reunification of the motherland; learn about achievements in foreign affairs since reform and opening up; learn about the important guiding significance of Deng Xiaoping Theory, the important thought of the "Three Represents," and the Scientific Outlook on Development for socialist modernization.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 中国特色社会主义进入新时代：知道中共十八大以来，中国特色社会主义进入新时代，党和人民面临的主要任务是，实现第一个百年奋斗目标，开启实现第二个百年奋斗目标新征程；了解习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想；通过新时代中国在经济建设、政治建设、文化建设、社会建设、生态文明建设等领域取得的成就，以及综合国力和国际影响力不断提高的史事，特别是取得脱贫攻坚的伟大胜利、全面建成小康社会的史事，认识中国特色社会主义建设对中国社会发展的意义及对世界的贡献；认识中国共产党百年奋斗的历史意义和历史经验。
text_en: Socialism with Chinese characteristics enters a new era: Know that since the Eighteenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China, socialism with Chinese characteristics has entered a new era, and that the main tasks facing the Party and the people are to achieve the first centenary goal and to embark on a new journey toward the second centenary goal; learn about Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era; through the achievements China has made in the new era in economic, political, cultural, social, and ecological civilization construction and other fields, and the events through which comprehensive national strength and international influence have continued to rise, especially the great victory in the fight against poverty and the building of a moderately prosperous society in all respects, recognize the significance of socialist construction with Chinese characteristics for China's social development and its contribution to the world; recognize the historical significance and historical experience of the Communist Party of China's century of struggle.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 古代文明：初步了解原始社会时期的人类活动；通过金字塔、《汉谟拉比法典》，以及种姓制度和佛教的创立，了解亚非古代文明及其传播；知道建立在奴隶制基础上的希腊城邦和罗马共和国，了解希腊、罗马的古典文化成就，以及亚历山大帝国、罗马帝国对文化传播和交流的作用。
text_en: Ancient civilizations: Begin to understand human activity in the period of primitive society; through the pyramids, the Code of Hammurabi, the caste system, and the founding of Buddhism, learn about the ancient civilizations of Asia and Africa and their spread; know the Greek city-states and the Roman Republic, which were built on a foundation of slavery, and learn about the achievements of classical Greek and Roman culture and the role of the Alexandrian Empire and the Roman Empire in the spread and exchange of culture.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 中古世界：通过封君封臣制、庄园生活、基督教的传播，以及欧洲城市和大学的兴起，了解中世纪西欧封建社会的发展变化；知道《查士丁尼法典》，初步了解拜占庭帝国的历史地位；通过伊斯兰教的创立、阿拉伯帝国的崛起、日本大化改新，以及非洲、美洲的社会发展概况，初步了解中古世界历史发展的多样性。
text_en: The medieval world: Through the system of lords and vassals, manorial life, the spread of Christianity, and the rise of European cities and universities, learn about the development and change of feudal society in medieval Western Europe; know the Code of Justinian and begin to understand the historical position of the Byzantine Empire; through the founding of Islam, the rise of the Arab Empire, Japan's Taika Reform, and an overview of social development in Africa and the Americas, begin to understand the diversity of historical development in the medieval world.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 近代早期西欧经济和社会变化：通过了解资本主义性质的手工工场和租地农场的出现，初步理解近代早期西欧社会经济的重要变化；通过了解欧洲兴起的文艺复兴运动及其代表人物和作品，如《神曲》、莎士比亚的戏剧，初步理解“人文主义”的发展及其对人的思想解放的意义。
text_en: Economic and social changes in early modern Western Europe: Through learning about the emergence of capitalist-type handicraft workshops and tenant farms, begin to understand the important changes in the society and economy of early modern Western Europe; through learning about the Renaissance movement that arose in Europe and its representative figures and works, such as the Divine Comedy and Shakespeare's plays, begin to understand the development of "humanism" and its significance for the intellectual emancipation of the individual.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 新航路的开辟：通过哥伦布、麦哲伦等航海家的探险活动，以及新航路开辟后的殖民扩张、物种交换和全球贸易，了解资本原始积累的野蛮性和残酷性，认识新航路开辟的世界影响，理解世界逐渐形成一个整体。
text_en: The opening of new sea routes: Through the voyages of explorers such as Columbus and Magellan, and the colonial expansion, exchange of species, and global trade that followed the opening of new sea routes, understand the savagery and cruelty of primitive capital accumulation, recognize the worldwide influence of the opening of new sea routes, and understand how the world gradually became a single whole.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 英、美、法资产阶级革命：知道英国1640年革命、美国独立战争和法国大革命的进程，了解《权利法案》《独立宣言》、1787年宪法和《人权宣言》《拿破仑法典》等文献的主要内容，初步认识这些资产阶级革命的历史意义。
text_en: The bourgeois revolutions in Britain, the United States, and France: Know the course of the English Revolution of 1640, the American War of Independence, and the French Revolution; learn about the main content of documents such as the Bill of Rights, the Declaration of Independence, the Constitution of 1787, the Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen, and the Napoleonic Code, and begin to recognize the historical significance of these bourgeois revolutions.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 第一次工业革命和马克思主义的诞生：通过了解珍妮机、蒸汽机、铁路和现代工厂制度，初步理解第一次工业革命的影响；通过了解早期工人阶级的斗争，马克思、恩格斯的革命活动和《共产党宣言》的发表，理解马克思主义诞生的历史意义；通过了解第一国际成立、巴黎公社，理解马克思主义的传播和国际工人运动的发展。
text_en: The First Industrial Revolution and the birth of Marxism: Through learning about the spinning jenny, the steam engine, railways, and the modern factory system, begin to understand the impact of the First Industrial Revolution; through learning about the early struggles of the working class, the revolutionary activities of Marx and Engels, and the publication of the Communist Manifesto, understand the historical significance of the birth of Marxism; through learning about the founding of the First International and the Paris Commune, understand the spread of Marxism and the development of the international workers' movement.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 殖民地人民的反抗与资本主义制度的扩展：通过了解拉丁美洲独立运动与印度民族大起义等史事，理解殖民地民族解放斗争的正义性和艰巨性；通过了解美国内战、日本明治维新、俄国1861年改革等史事，初步认识资本主义世界体系的形成。
text_en: Resistance of colonial peoples and the expansion of the capitalist system: Through learning about events such as the Latin American independence movements and the Indian Rebellion (Great Uprising), understand the justice and arduousness of the national liberation struggles of colonial peoples; through learning about events such as the American Civil War, Japan's Meiji Restoration, and Russia's 1861 reform, begin to recognize the formation of the capitalist world system.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 科学技术的发展与第二次工业革命：通过了解第二次工业革命的主要领域和代表性成果，初步理解科学技术发展带来的社会进步和社会问题。
text_en: The development of science and technology and the Second Industrial Revolution: Through learning about the main fields and representative achievements of the Second Industrial Revolution, begin to understand the social progress and social problems brought by the development of science and technology.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 近代科学与艺术成就：通过了解牛顿、达尔文、巴尔扎克、贝多芬等人的成就，初步理解科学和文化在近代社会发展中的重要作用。
text_en: Achievements in modern science and the arts: Through learning about the achievements of figures such as Newton, Darwin, Balzac, and Beethoven, begin to understand the important role of science and culture in the development of modern society.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 第一次世界大战与俄国十月革命：通过了解“三国同盟”和“三国协约”、萨拉热窝事件、凡尔登战役等，分析第一次世界大战爆发的原因，了解其基本进程以及给人类社会带来的巨大灾难；知道列宁领导的十月革命的背景与过程，理解十月革命胜利的重要历史意义；知道凡尔赛体系、华盛顿体系和国际联盟，了解战后战胜国建立的世界秩序及其局限性。
text_en: World War I and the Russian October Revolution: Through learning about the "Triple Alliance" and the "Triple Entente," the Sarajevo Incident, the Battle of Verdun, and so on, analyze the causes of the outbreak of World War I, and learn its basic course and the enormous disaster it brought to human society; know the background and course of the October Revolution led by Lenin and understand the important historical significance of its victory; know the Versailles system, the Washington system, and the League of Nations, and learn about the world order established by the victorious powers after the war and its limitations.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 两次世界大战之间的世界政治与经济：通过了解新经济政策、社会主义工业化、农业集体化等举措，认识苏联社会主义建设的重要成就和主要问题；通过了解印度的非暴力不合作运动、埃及的华夫脱运动、墨西哥的卡德纳斯改革，分析两次世界大战期间亚非拉民族民主运动的特点；通过了解经济大危机和罗斯福“新政”，初步理解国家干预政策对西方经济的影响。
text_en: World politics and economy between the two world wars: Through learning about measures such as the New Economic Policy, socialist industrialization, and agricultural collectivization, recognize the major achievements and main problems of socialist construction in the Soviet Union; through learning about India's non-violent non-cooperation movement, Egypt's Wafd movement, and Mexico's Cardenas reforms, analyze the characteristics of the national and democratic movements in Asia, Africa, and Latin America during the interwar period; through learning about the Great Depression and Roosevelt's "New Deal," begin to understand the impact of state-intervention policies on Western economies.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 第二次世界大战：通过了解日本对中国的侵略、意大利法西斯和纳粹德国的对外扩张，知道德国、意大利、日本侵略集团是发动第二次世界大战的罪魁祸首；知道第二次世界大战的主要进程和主要战场，知道《联合国家宣言》和开罗会议、雅尔塔会议、波茨坦会议等重要国际会议，了解世界人民反法西斯战争的艰巨性和胜利原因。
text_en: World War II: Through learning about Japan's aggression against China and the external expansion of Italian fascism and Nazi Germany, know that the aggressor bloc of Germany, Italy, and Japan was the chief culprit in launching World War II; know the main course and main theaters of World War II, know the Declaration by United Nations and important international conferences such as the Cairo Conference, the Yalta Conference, and the Potsdam Conference, and learn about the arduousness of the world peoples' anti-fascist war and the reasons for its victory.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 第二次世界大战后世界的新变化：通过了解杜鲁门主义、马歇尔计划、德国分裂、“北约”与“华约”的建立，认识美苏“冷战”对峙局面的形成；通过了解美国和日本经济的发展，欧洲联合趋势的发展以及社会保障制度的建立，初步理解战后资本主义发展的新特点；了解社会主义从一国到多国的实践，知道社会主义阵营的形成和苏联的改革，了解东欧剧变和苏联解体，认识中国特色社会主义建设的意义；通过万隆会议、“非洲年”、巴拿马收回运河主权等史事，知道战后殖民体系的崩溃和亚非拉国家为捍卫国家主权、发展经济所进行的斗争。
text_en: New changes in the world after World War II: Through learning about the Truman Doctrine, the Marshall Plan, the division of Germany, and the establishment of NATO and the Warsaw Pact, recognize the formation of the US-Soviet "Cold War" confrontation; through learning about the economic development of the United States and Japan, the development of the trend toward European unification, and the establishment of social security systems, begin to understand the new characteristics of postwar capitalist development; learn about the practice of socialism expanding from one country to many, know the formation of the socialist camp and the reforms in the Soviet Union, learn about the drastic changes in Eastern Europe and the dissolution of the Soviet Union, and recognize the significance of building socialism with Chinese characteristics; through events such as the Bandung Conference, the "Year of Africa," and Panama's recovery of sovereignty over the canal, know the collapse of the postwar colonial system and the struggles of Asian, African, and Latin American countries to defend national sovereignty and develop their economies.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 当今世界的主要发展趋势：通过世界多极化、经济全球化、社会信息化和文化多样化，了解现代世界的基本特点；知道人口、资源、环境、传染病、社会治理等人类发展面临的共同问题；通过了解联合国、世界贸易组织等，认识世界各国为解决全球性问题所作出的努力；知道和平、发展、合作、共贏是时代潮流，了解构建人类命运共同体理念的重要意义。
text_en: Main trends of development in today's world: Through world multipolarization, economic globalization, social informatization, and cultural diversification, learn about the basic characteristics of the modern world; know the common problems facing human development, such as population, resources, the environment, infectious diseases, and social governance; through learning about the United Nations, the World Trade Organization, and so on, recognize the efforts countries around the world have made to solve global problems; know that peace, development, cooperation, and win-win outcomes are the trend of the times, and learn about the important significance of the concept of building a community with a shared future for humankind.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题一 地球的宇宙环境
text_zh: 结合科学故事、史实材料等，说出人类对地球形状的认识过程，使用数据、类比等方式描述地球的大小。
text_en: Drawing on scientific stories and historical materials, describe how humans' understanding of the shape of the Earth developed, and use data, analogies and other means to describe the size of the Earth.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题一 地球的宇宙环境
text_zh: 运用图片、影视资料以及数字技术等手段，描述地球的宇宙环境、地球在太阳系中的位置，认识地球是人类唯一的家园。
text_en: Using pictures, film and video materials, digital technology and other means, describe the Earth's cosmic environment and its position in the solar system, and recognize that the Earth is humanity's only home.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题一 地球的宇宙环境
text_zh: 结合图片、影视资料等，描述探月工程、火星探测以及空间站建设等人类太空探索的进展与意义。
text_en: Using pictures, film and video materials, etc., describe the progress and significance of human space exploration, such as the lunar exploration programme, Mars exploration and space station construction.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题一 地球的宇宙环境
text_zh: 收集中国航天及太空观测发展的相关材料，举例说出中国太空探索的成就。
text_en: Collect materials on the development of China's space and astronomical observation programmes, and cite examples to state China's achievements in space exploration.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题二 地球的运动
text_zh: 运用地球仪或软件，演示地球的自转运动，说出地球的自转方向、周期。
text_en: Using a globe or software, demonstrate the Earth's rotation, and state the direction and period of the Earth's rotation.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题二 地球的运动
text_zh: 结合实例，说出地球自转产生的主要自然现象及其对人们生产生活的影响。
text_en: Drawing on examples, state the main natural phenomena produced by the Earth's rotation and their effects on people's production and daily life.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题二 地球的运动
text_zh: 运用模型或软件，演示地球的公转运动，说出地球的公转方向、周期。
text_en: Using a model or software, demonstrate the Earth's revolution around the Sun, and state the direction and period of the Earth's revolution.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题二 地球的运动
text_zh: 结合实例，说出地球公转产生的主要自然现象及其对人们生产生活的影响。
text_en: Drawing on examples, state the main natural phenomena produced by the Earth's revolution and their effects on people's production and daily life.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题三 地球的表层
text_zh: 阅读世界地图，描述世界海陆分布状况，说出七大洲、四大洋的分布。
text_en: Read a world map, describe the distribution of land and sea in the world, and state the distribution of the seven continents and four oceans.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题三 地球的表层
text_zh: 通过阅读地形图、图像，观看影视资料，观察地形模型或实地考察等，区别山地、丘陵、高原、平原、盆地的形态特征。
text_en: By reading topographic maps and images, watching film and video materials, observing relief models or conducting field investigations, distinguish the morphological features of mountains, hills, plateaus, plains and basins.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题三 地球的表层
text_zh: 在世界地形图上指出陆地主要地形和海底主要地形的分布，观察地形分布大势。
text_en: On a world topographic map, point out the distribution of the main landforms on land and on the seafloor, and observe the general pattern of landform distribution.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题三 地球的表层
text_zh: 结合实例，说明海洋和陆地处于不断的运动变化之中；说出板块构造学说的基本观点，并解释世界火山、地震带的分布与板块运动的关系。
text_en: Drawing on examples, explain that oceans and land are in constant motion and change; state the basic tenets of plate tectonics, and explain the relationship between the distribution of the world's volcanic and earthquake belts and plate movement.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题三 地球的表层
text_zh: 结合实例，说出海洋对人们生产生活的影响。（2）天气与气候
text_en: Drawing on examples, state the effects of the oceans on people's production and daily life. (2) Weather and Climate

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题三 地球的表层
text_zh: 收看天气预报节目，识别常见的天气符号，模拟播报天气。
text_en: Watch weather forecast programmes, identify common weather symbols, and simulate presenting a weather forecast.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题三 地球的表层
text_zh: 阅读世界年平均气温和1月、7月平均气温分布图，描述和简要归纳世界气温分布特点。
text_en: Read maps of world annual mean temperature and of January and July mean temperatures, and describe and briefly summarize the characteristics of the world's temperature distribution.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题三 地球的表层
text_zh: 阅读世界年降水量分布图，描述和简要归纳世界降水分布特点。
text_en: Read a map of world annual precipitation, and describe and briefly summarize the characteristics of the world's precipitation distribution.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题三 地球的表层
text_zh: 阅读某地区气温、降水数据资料，并据此绘制气温曲线图和降水量柱状图，说出气温与降水量随时间变化的特点。
text_en: Read temperature and precipitation data for a given region, and on that basis draw a temperature curve graph and a precipitation bar chart, and state how temperature and precipitation change over time.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题三 地球的表层
text_zh: 阅读世界气候类型分布图，描述世界主要气候类型的分布特征；结合实例，说明纬度位置、海陆分布、地形等对气候的影响。
text_en: Read a map of the distribution of world climate types, and describe the distribution characteristics of the world's main climate types; drawing on examples, explain the effects of latitude, the distribution of land and sea, terrain and other factors on climate.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题三 地球的表层
text_zh: 结合实例，说明天气和气候对人们生产生活的影响。
text_en: Drawing on examples, explain the effects of weather and climate on people's production and daily life.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题三 地球的表层
text_zh: 运用地图和相关资料，描述并简要归纳世界人口数量变化和人口空间分布特点。
text_en: Using maps and related materials, describe and briefly summarize the changes in the size of the world's population and the characteristics of its spatial distribution.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题三 地球的表层
text_zh: 通过阅读图像、观看视频或实地考察等，描述城镇与乡村的景观特征及其变化。
text_en: By reading images, watching videos or conducting field investigations, describe the landscape characteristics of cities and towns and of rural areas, and how they change.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题三 地球的表层
text_zh: 运用反映人种、语言、宗教、习俗等内容的图文资料，描述世界文化的丰富多彩，树立尊重世界文化多样性的意识。（2）发展与合作
text_en: Using illustrated materials on race, language, religion, customs and other aspects, describe the rich diversity of world cultures, and develop an awareness of respect for the diversity of world cultures. (2) Development and Cooperation

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题三 地球的表层
text_zh: 以某发达国家和某发展中国家为例，描述不同国家发展水平的差异。
text_en: Taking a developed country and a developing country as examples, describe the differences in development levels between countries.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题三 地球的表层
text_zh: 结合实例，说明交通运输在全球经济发展中的重要作用。
text_en: Drawing on examples, explain the important role of transport in global economic development.

subject: social-studies
subtopic_zh: 主题三 地球的表层
text_zh: 结合实例，说明加强国际合作的重要意义。
text_en: Drawing on examples, explain the significance of strengthening international cooperation.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用地图和相关资料，描述某大洲的地理位置，并依据大洲地理位置特点，判断大洲所处热量带和降水的空间分布概况。
text_en: Using maps and related materials, describe the geographical location of a continent, and, on the basis of the characteristics of its location, judge the heat zone it lies in and the general spatial distribution of its precipitation.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用地图和相关资料，简要归纳某大洲的地形、气候、人口、经济等地理特征。①青藏高原被称为“第三极”。
text_en: Using maps and related materials, briefly summarize the geographical characteristics of a continent, such as its terrain, climate, population and economy. ① The Qinghai-Tibet Plateau is known as the "Third Pole".

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用地图和相关资料，描述某地区的地理位置，简要归纳自然地理特征，说明该特征对当地人们生产生活的影响。
text_en: Using maps and related materials, describe the geographical location of a region, briefly summarize its physical geographical characteristics, and explain the effects of these characteristics on local people's production and daily life.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 以某地区的一种自然资源为例，说出该资源在当地的分布状况、对外输出地区以及对当地乃至世界的重要意义。
text_en: Taking one natural resource of a region as an example, state the distribution of that resource locally, the areas to which it is exported, and its importance to the locality and even to the world.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 结合实例，说明某地区发展旅游业的优势。
text_en: Drawing on examples, explain the advantages of a region for developing tourism.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 根据南极、北极地区自然地理环境的特殊性，说明开展极地科学考察和保护极地环境的重要性。
text_en: On the basis of the special features of the natural geographical environment of the Antarctic and the Arctic, explain the importance of conducting polar scientific expeditions and protecting the polar environment.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用地图和相关资料，说出某国家的地理位置、范围、领土构成和首都；选择与该国地理位置差异明显的国家，比较它们纬度位置和海陆位置的差异。
text_en: Using maps and related materials, state the geographical location, extent, territorial composition and capital of a country; choose a country whose geographical location differs markedly from it, and compare the differences in their latitudinal and land-sea positions.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用地图和相关资料，描述某国家突出的自然地理特征。
text_en: Using maps and related materials, describe the prominent physical geographical features of a country.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用地图和相关资料，说出某国家人文地理主要特点及其与自然地理环境的联系。
text_en: Using maps and related materials, state the main characteristics of the human geography of a country and their connections with its natural geographical environment.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用地图和相关资料，联系某国家的自然地理环境特点，结合实例简要分析该国因地制宜发展经济的途径。
text_en: Using maps and related materials, and linking to the characteristics of a country's natural geographical environment, briefly analyze, with examples, the ways in which that country develops its economy in a manner suited to local conditions.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用地图和相关资料，简要分析某国家在资源开发、环境保护方面的经验和教训。
text_en: Using maps and related materials, briefly analyze a country's experience and lessons in resource development and environmental protection.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 结合实例，简要说明一个国家对某地自然环境的改造活动对其他地方自然环境的影响。
text_en: Drawing on examples, briefly explain the effects that one country's activities to transform the natural environment of a place have on the natural environment of other places.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 结合某国家的实例，简要说明该国家与其他国家在经济社会等方面的联系及其意义。说明：（1）本主题规定从世界范围内选学部分大洲、地区、国家，旨在使学生认识区域自然地理环境和人文地理环境的主要特征，初步掌握认识区域地理特征的基本方法。（2）从世界范围内选择区域进行学习时，除南极和北极地区是必学区域外，还需从世界范围内至少选择一个大洲、三个地区和四个国家作为必学内容。（3）所选择的“大洲一地区一国家”组合必须涉及所有大洲，其内容必须涵盖本主题全部的“内容要求”。就某一个区域而言，可以落实若干条“内容要求”，合理组织相关素材。
text_en: Drawing on the example of a country, briefly explain the economic, social and other links between that country and other countries, and their significance. Notes: (1) This theme stipulates that some continents, regions and countries from around the world are to be selected for study, so that students recognize the main characteristics of the natural and human geographical environments of regions and gain an initial grasp of the basic methods of understanding regional geographical characteristics. (2) When selecting regions from around the world for study, besides the Antarctic and the Arctic, which are compulsory regions, at least one continent, three regions and four countries from around the world must also be chosen as compulsory content. (3) The selected "continent-region-country" combinations must involve all the continents, and their content must cover all of the "content requirements" of this theme. For any one region, a number of "content requirements" may be addressed, with the relevant materials organized reasonably.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用地图，描述中国的地理位置与疆域特征，说明南海诸岛是中国领土的组成部分，钓鱼岛及其附属岛屿是中国固有领土，增强国家版图意识与海洋权益意识。
text_en: Using maps, describe China's geographical location and territorial characteristics, explain that the South China Sea Islands are part of China's territory and that the Diaoyu Island and its affiliated islands are China's inherent territory, and strengthen awareness of the national map and of maritime rights and interests.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用中国行政区划图，识别34个省级行政区，记住它们的简称和行政中心。
text_en: Using a map of China's administrative divisions, identify the 34 provincial-level administrative regions, and remember their abbreviated names and administrative centres.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用地图和相关资料，简要归纳中国地形、气候、河湖等的特征；简要分析影响中国气候的主要因素。
text_en: Using maps and related materials, briefly summarize the characteristics of China's terrain, climate, rivers and lakes, etc.; briefly analyze the main factors that influence China's climate.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用地图和相关资料，描述长江、黄河的特点，举例说明其对经济发展和人们生活的影响。
text_en: Using maps and related materials, describe the characteristics of the Yangtze River and the Yellow River, and cite examples to explain their effects on economic development and people's lives.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用地图和相关资料，描述中国人口的基本状况和变化。
text_en: Using maps and related materials, describe the basic situation of China's population and its changes.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用地图和相关资料，简要归纳中国的民族分布特点，树立中华民族共同体意识。
text_en: Using maps and related materials, briefly summarize the characteristics of the distribution of China's ethnic groups, and foster a sense of community for the Chinese nation.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用地图和相关资料，描述中国水资源、土地资源、矿产资源和海洋资源等自然资源的主要特征，举例说明自然资源与人们生产生活的关系，认识开发、利用、保护自然资源的重要意义。
text_en: Using maps and related materials, describe the main characteristics of China's natural resources such as water resources, land resources, mineral resources and marine resources, cite examples to explain the relationship between natural resources and people's production and daily life, and recognize the importance of developing, utilizing and protecting natural resources.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 借助地图和相关资料，举例描述中国农业、工业等生产活动的分布，并用实例说明科学技术在产业发展中的重要作用。
text_en: With the aid of maps and related materials, cite examples to describe the distribution of China's agricultural, industrial and other production activities, and use examples to show the important role of science and technology in industrial development.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用地图和相关资料，说明中国交通运输线的分布特征，以及高速公路、高速铁路的快速发展对人们生产生活的影响。
text_en: Using maps and related materials, explain the distribution characteristics of China's transport routes, and the effects of the rapid development of expressways and high-speed railways on people's production and daily life.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用地图和相关资料，描述中国主要的自然灾害和环境问题；针对某一自然灾害或环境问题提出合理的防治建议；掌握一定的气象灾害和地质灾害的安全防护技能。
text_en: Using maps and related materials, describe China's main natural disasters and environmental problems; put forward reasonable prevention and control suggestions for a particular natural disaster or environmental problem; and master certain safety protection skills for meteorological disasters and geological disasters.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用地图、图像等资料，说明秦岭一淮河等重要自然地理界线在地理分区中的意义。
text_en: Using maps, images and other materials, explain the significance of important physical geographical boundaries, such as the Qinling Mountains-Huaihe River line, in geographical regionalization.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用地图和相关资料，说出某区域的地理位置和自然地理特征，说明自然条件对该区域经济社会发展的影响，认识因地制宜的重要性。
text_en: Using maps and related materials, state the geographical location and physical geographical characteristics of a region, explain the effects of natural conditions on the region's economic and social development, and recognize the importance of adapting measures to local conditions.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 结合实例，描述不同区域的差异，说明区域联系和协同发展对经济社会发展的意义。
text_en: Drawing on examples, describe the differences between regions, and explain the significance of regional links and coordinated development for economic and social development.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用地图和相关资料，描述某区域城乡分布和变化，推测该区域城乡发展图景。
text_en: Using maps and related materials, describe the distribution of urban and rural areas in a region and its changes, and infer the prospects for urban and rural development in the region.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 进行野外考察或运用相关资料，说明自然环境与地方文化景观之间的关系。
text_en: Conduct field investigations or use related materials to explain the relationship between the natural environment and local cultural landscapes.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用地图和相关资料，说明北京的自然地理特点、历史文化传统和城市建设成就，认识首都职能。
text_en: Using maps and related materials, explain Beijing's physical geographical characteristics, historical and cultural traditions and achievements in urban construction, and recognize the functions of a capital city.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用地图和相关资料，说明香港、澳门的自然地理、历史文化传统和经济建设特点，以及港澳与内地经济发展的相互促进作用，增强区域联系的意识。
text_en: Using maps and related materials, explain the physical geography, historical and cultural traditions and economic development characteristics of Hong Kong and Macao, and the mutual promotion between the economic development of Hong Kong and Macao and that of the Mainland, and strengthen awareness of regional links.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 运用地图和相关资料，说明台湾的自然地理、历史文化传统和经济建设特点，认识台湾自古以来就是中国不可分割的领士，以及促进海峡两岸经济社会融合发展的意义。
text_en: Using maps and related materials, explain Taiwan's physical geography, historical and cultural traditions and economic development characteristics, recognize that Taiwan has been an inalienable part of China's territory since ancient times, and recognize the significance of promoting the integrated economic and social development of the two sides of the Taiwan Strait.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 进行野外考察并利用图文资料，描述家乡典型的自然与人文地理事物和现象，归纳家乡地理环境的特点，举例说明其形成过程及原因。
text_en: Conduct field investigations and use illustrated materials to describe typical natural and human geographical features and phenomena of one's hometown, summarize the characteristics of its geographical environment, and cite examples to explain their formation processes and causes.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 与他人交流各自对家乡的看法并说明理由，感悟人们在不同体验和感知背景下对家乡形成的不同看法。
text_en: Exchange with others their respective views of their hometowns and explain the reasons, and appreciate that people form different views of their hometowns against different backgrounds of experience and perception.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 举例说明家乡环境及生产发展给当地居民生活带来的影响和变化，并尝试用绿色发展理念，对家乡的发展规划提出合理建议，增强热爱家乡、建设家乡的意识。说明：（1）除北京、香港、澳门、台湾外，还需从全国范围内至少选择五个不同空间尺度或不同类型的区域作为必学内容。（2）家乡范围一般指县一级行政区。根据各地实际情况，认识家乡内容的教学可讲授本地区（省辖市）地理，或者本省（自治区、直辖市）地理。认识家乡的内容可以融入“认识中国全貌”和“认识分区”中，也可以单独教学。（3）从本主题“内容要求”中至少选择一条，以实践活动的方式展开教学。
text_en: Cite examples to explain the influence and changes that the hometown environment and production development have brought to local residents' lives, and try to use the concept of green development to put forward reasonable suggestions for the development plan of one's hometown, strengthening the awareness of loving and building one's hometown. Notes: (1) Besides Beijing, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan, at least five regions of different spatial scales or different types from across the country must also be chosen as compulsory content. (2) The scope of one's hometown generally refers to a county-level administrative region. Depending on local circumstances, teaching on understanding one's hometown may cover the geography of the local area (prefecture-level city) or of the province (autonomous region, municipality directly under the central government). The content on understanding one's hometown may be integrated into "Understanding China as a Whole" and "Understanding Regional Divisions", or taught separately. (3) At least one of the "content requirements" of this theme must be selected and taught through practical activities.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 观察地球仪，并用简易材料制作地球仪模型。
text_en: Observe a globe, and make a globe model from simple materials.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 在地球仪上识别经线和纬线，说出经度和纬度的分布规律；用经纬度描述某一地理事物或现象所在地的位置。
text_en: On a globe, identify meridians and parallels, and state the distribution patterns of longitude and latitude; use longitude and latitude to describe the location of a geographical feature or phenomenon.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 在地球仪上识别两极、赤道、南北回归线、南北极圈、本初子午线等，说出划分南北半球、东西半球的依据。（2）地图
text_en: On a globe, identify the poles, the Equator, the Tropics of Cancer and Capricorn, the Arctic and Antarctic Circles, the Prime Meridian, etc., and state the basis for dividing the Northern and Southern Hemispheres and the Eastern and Western Hemispheres. (2) Maps

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 在地图上辨别方向，判读经度和纬度，量算距离，识别图例所表示的地理事物或现象，并描述地理事物或现象的空间分布特征。
text_en: On a map, identify directions, read longitude and latitude, measure and calculate distances, identify the geographical features or phenomena represented by legend symbols, and describe the spatial distribution characteristics of geographical features or phenomena.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 结合地形观察，说出等高线地形图、分层设色地形图表示地形的方法；在地形图上识别一些基本地形。
text_en: Combined with observation of terrain, state how contour topographic maps and layer-tinted topographic maps represent terrain; identify some basic landforms on a topographic map.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 根据需要选择适用的地图，查找所需要的地理信息，养成使用地图的习惯。
text_en: Choose a suitable map as needed, look up the geographical information required, and develop the habit of using maps.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 结合生活实例，描述数字地图和卫星导航系统给人们生活带来的便捷。
text_en: Drawing on examples from daily life, describe the convenience that digital maps and satellite navigation systems bring to people's lives.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 结合实例，描述数字地图在城市管理、资源调查、灾害监测等方面的应用。
text_en: Drawing on examples, describe applications of digital maps in urban management, resource surveys, disaster monitoring and other areas.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 设计简单的实验方案，利用模拟、虚拟等方式开展地理实验。
text_en: Design a simple experimental plan, and carry out geographical experiments by means of simulation, virtual methods and the like.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 设计简单的调查方案，利用问卷、访谈等形式进行社会调查。
text_en: Design a simple survey plan, and carry out social surveys by means of questionnaires, interviews and the like.

subject: social-studies
text_zh: 设计简单的考察方案，利用工具进行观察、观测等野外考察。
text_en: Design a simple field investigation plan, and carry out field investigations such as observation and measurement using tools.

subject: cs
text_zh: 在日常学习与生活场景中，通过教师指导，尝试使用数字设备与数字资源开展识字、朗读和阅读等活动，扩充语言学习的手段与方法。
text_en: In everyday learning and life scenarios, with the teacher's guidance, try using digital devices and digital resources to carry out activities such as literacy, reading aloud and reading, expanding the means and methods of language learning.

subject: cs
text_zh: 在家庭、校园、公园等场景中，体验、感受与智能语音助手、电子导览等数字设备的交互过程。
text_en: In scenarios such as the home, school and park, experience and feel the process of interacting with digital devices such as intelligent voice assistants and electronic guides.

subject: cs
text_zh: 通过拍照、录音、录像、语音输入、录入文字或图符等方式记录自己的见闻和想法，与师长、同伴交流分享。
text_en: Record one's own observations and ideas by taking photos, recording audio, recording video, voice input, and entering text or icons, and communicate and share them with teachers, elders and peers.

subject: cs
text_zh: 在浏览他人数字作品时，能主动、真诚、友善地发表评论，用恰当的数字化方式加以表达，如“点赞”等。
text_en: When browsing others' digital works, be able to comment proactively, sincerely and kindly, and express oneself in appropriate digital ways, such as "liking".

subject: cs
text_zh: 通过数字设备辅助学习、交流与分享，激发对信息科技的好奇心和学习兴趣，产生对信息科技的求知欲。
text_en: Use digital devices to assist learning, communication and sharing, stimulate curiosity and interest in learning about information technology, and develop a desire to learn about information technology.

subject: cs
text_zh: 在学习与生活中，能用正确的姿势使用数字设备，养成好习惯，注意保护视力。
text_en: In learning and daily life, be able to use digital devices with correct posture, develop good habits, and take care to protect eyesight.

subject: cs
text_zh: 在各种在线活动中，能在教师指导下辨别信息真伪，知道个人信息保护的重要性，养成保护个人信息的好习惯。
text_en: In various online activities, with the teacher's guidance, be able to tell true information from false, know the importance of protecting personal information, and develop the good habit of protecting personal information.

subject: cs
text_zh: 能对数字设备记录的文字、图片、音频、视频等信息进行分类、保存与提取。
text_en: Be able to classify, save and retrieve information recorded by digital devices, such as text, pictures, audio and video.

subject: cs
text_zh: 能在分享他人数字作品时标注来源，尊重数字作品所有者的权益。
text_en: Be able to indicate the source when sharing others' digital works, and respect the rights and interests of the owners of digital works.

subject: cs
text_zh: 合理安排数字设备的使用时间，了解健康使用数字设备的重要性。
text_en: Arrange the time spent using digital devices sensibly, and understand the importance of using digital devices in a healthy way.

subject: cs
text_zh: 在线交流时，了解在网络空间也要遵守日常行为规范。
text_en: When communicating online, understand that everyday norms of conduct must also be observed in cyberspace.

subject: cs
text_zh: 在使用数字设备时不打扰他人，自觉维护社会公共秩序。
text_en: When using digital devices, do not disturb others, and consciously maintain public order.
