"Viewing" among language skills usually refers to the skill of understanding meaning by using graphics, tables, animations, symbols, and video in multimodal texts. To understand multimodal texts, besides using traditional reading skills, one also needs to observe the information in charts and graphs and understand the meaning of symbols and animations. Receptive skills and productive skills complement and promote each other in the process of language learning. For specific content requirements, see Tables 15 to 19.

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 在交流中注意倾听、积极思考；
text_en: Listen attentively and think actively in communication;

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 尝试运用多种途径学习英语，遇到问题主动向老师或同学元认知策略请教；
text_en: Try to use a variety of ways to learn English, and take the initiative to ask the teacher or classmates when problems arise [metacognitive strategies];

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 在教师指导下制订简单的学习计划，并付诸行动；
text_en: Under the teacher's guidance, draw up a simple study plan and put it into action;

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 能意识到自己英语学习中的进步与不足，并作出适当调整。学习策略
text_en: Be aware of one's own progress and shortcomings in learning English, and make appropriate adjustments. [Learning strategies]

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 在词语与相应事物之间建立联系；
text_en: Build connections between words and the corresponding things;

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 在新旧语言知识之间建立联系；
text_en: Build connections between new and old language knowledge;

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 在搅中学习词汇和语法；认知
text_en: Learn vocabulary and grammar in context; [cognitive]

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 通过分类等方法加深对词汇的理解和记忆；策略
text_en: Deepen understanding and memory of vocabulary by methods such as classification; [strategies]

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 积极运用所学英语进行表达和交流；
text_en: Actively use the English learned to express oneself and communicate;

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 注意观察生活和媒体中使用的简单英语。
text_en: Pay attention to the simple English used in daily life and the media.

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 运用已有语言积累和生活经验完成新的学习任务；
text_en: Use existing language accumulation and life experience to complete new learning tasks;

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 借助图表、思维导图等工具归纳、整理所学内容；认知
text_en: Use tools such as charts and mind maps to summarize and organize what has been learned; [cognitive]

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 借助拼读规则拼读生词；策略
text_en: Read new words aloud with the help of phonics rules; [strategies]

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 在学习内容与个人经历之间建立有意义的联系；
text_en: Build meaningful connections between learning content and personal experience;

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 在学习中利用不同感官增强理解和记忆；
text_en: Use different senses in learning to strengthen understanding and memory;

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 在学习中善于抓要点、记笔记；
text_en: Be good at grasping key points and taking notes in learning;

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 整理、归纳所学内容，把握重点和难点；
text_en: Organize and summarize what has been learned, and grasp key and difficult points;

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 在学习中善于利用信息结构图等理解主题；
text_en: Be good at using information structure diagrams and the like to understand a topic in learning;

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 运用多种方法、借助多种资源学习和记忆词语，如拼读、联想、搭配、分类，以及构词法等；
text_en: Use a variety of methods and resources to learn and remember words, such as phonics, association, collocation, classification, and word formation;

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 从形式，意义和使用三个角度关注和学习语法，善于发现认知策略语言规律，并能运用规律举一反三；
text_en: Attend to and learn grammar from the three perspectives of form, meaning, and use, be good at discovering language patterns [cognitive strategies] and be able to apply the patterns to other cases;

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 了解和运用各种阅读技巧和策略，如预测、略读、猜测词义、推断、理解篇章（或语篇）结构和指示代词的指代意义等，提升阅读的兴趣与能力；
text_en: Understand and use various reading skills and strategies, such as predicting, skimming, guessing word meaning, inferring, understanding text structure and the referents of pronouns, so as to increase interest in and ability of reading;

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 了解和运用基本的写作技巧和策略，如审题、选材、列提纲、修改习作和积累词句等，提升写作能力；
text_en: Understand and use basic writing skills and strategies, such as analyzing the prompt, selecting material, drawing up an outline, revising one's writing, and accumulating words and sentences, so as to improve writing ability;

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 在学习和使用英语时，意识到错误并进行自我纠正；
text_en: In learning and using English, be aware of errors and correct them oneself;

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 有效地借助母语知识理解英语。级别学习策略
text_en: Make effective use of knowledge of the mother tongue to understand English. [Level; learning strategies]

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 对英语学习保持主动性和积极性，激发动机，端正态度，降低焦虑，保持自信；情感管理
text_en: Remain proactive and positive about learning English, stimulate motivation, adopt a correct attitude, reduce anxiety, and maintain confidence; [affective management]

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 乐于参与课内外英语实践活动，积极沟通表达，不怕犯错；策略
text_en: Be glad to take part in in-class and out-of-class English practice activities, communicate and express actively, and not be afraid of making mistakes; [strategies]

subject: world-languages
text_zh: 在学习和运用英语的过程中调控自己的情绪，取得成绩不盲目骄傲，遇到问题不轻言放弃，有一定的抗挫折能力。
text_en: In the process of learning and using English, regulate one's own emotions, not be blindly proud of achievements, not give up easily when encountering problems, and have a certain resilience in the face of setbacks.
